# 2012: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 5,790 Wikipedia event assertions across 366 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2012.sqlite](2012.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `e681dd10c70a5ee393040c95efb8bf19f97e48b4c9be17c2f7f0a44848f9a950`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.1`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.3`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 34. Separate editorial evidence: 0; explicitly unverified: 34. Unverified means no full-event verification is established; research may be incomplete or not attempted. An unsuccessful search does not establish that a claim is false. Full-event reviews complete: 0; partial: 0; without a full-event review: 5,790. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## Scoped research findings

These observations cover the specified passages only. They do not establish full-event verification.

- **2012-01-14.** Network opening-date table The table dates the Circle Line extension at Bayfront and Marina Bay to January 14. The complete routing and operator clauses were not assessed. Evidence: [SGTrains](<https://www.sgtrains.com/network-figures.html>) (opened).

- **2012-01-15.** Diamond Resorts episode notices Later episode notices identify January 15, 2012 as the original broadcast. The season-premiere designation was not independently established. Evidence: [CBS / Paramount Press Express](<https://www.paramountpressexpress.com/cbs-entertainment/shows/undercover-boss/releases?episode=19449>) (opened).

- **2012-01-20.** January highlights, Finding Stuff Out section The advance schedule announces a January 20 premiere. An advance announcement alone does not establish that the broadcast occurred. Evidence: [TVO via PR Newswire](<https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/a-pre-dictatorship-castro-on-camera-the-kings-speech-dissected-and-david-tennant-as-a-father-in-love-after-losing-his-partner-all-in-tvos-january-2012-highlights-135096553.html>) (opened).

- **2012-01-22.** Games dates and medal table The city records January 13–22 and a gold-medal ranking led by Germany, China and Austria. That ranking is not a ranking by total medals: Germany and Russia each total 17. The closing ceremony itself was not separately checked. Evidence: [City of Innsbruck](<https://www.innsbruck.gv.at/en/freizeit/sport/olympiastadt-innsbruck/youth-olympic-games-2012-premiere-fuer-die-jugend>) (opened).

- **2012-02-17.** Early day motion, Leeds Rhinos 2012 Rugby League World Champions The parliamentary motion records Leeds beating Manly 26–12 on February 17 for a third title. This is an attributed parliamentary congratulatory statement, not an exhaustive review of every source clause. Evidence: [UK Parliament](<https://edm.parliament.uk/early-day-motion/43837/leeds-rhinos-2012-rugby-league-world-champions>) (opened).

- **2012-02-20.** February 20 report, GDP figures and forecast The report gives a 10.7 percent quarterly contraction and 9 percent yearly contraction for the fourth quarter, with 7 percent appearing as a growth forecast. It does not corroborate the source assertion of a 7 percent contraction. Evidence: [AFP via Business Recorder](<https://www.brecorder.com/news/46387/thai-economy-shrinks-107pc-on-flood-impact>) (opened).

- **2012-02-26.** February 24, 2015 statement, case background The statement identifies the fatal shooting in Sanford on February 26, 2012 and Zimmerman. It does not establish every descriptive detail of the original assertion. Evidence: [US Department of Justice](<https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/federal-officials-close-investigation-death-trayvon-martin>) (opened).

- **2012-03-17.** Classic match account, 2012 Wales–France The account supports the March 17 win over France and Grand Slam. The ordinal claim about the total number of Grand Slams was not independently established from the opened passage. Evidence: [Six Nations Rugby](<https://www.sixnationsrugby.com/en/m6n/news/classic-matches-wales-seal-2012-grand-slam-against-france-in-cardiff>) (opened).

- **2012-03-22.** Announcement labeled March 25, 2013 The label announcement concerns the band ending in 2013, rather than the original portal assertion’s 2012 year. The precise March 22 announcement date was not established by this March 25 page alone. The original archive date and wording remain unchanged. Evidence: [Warner Music Japan](<https://wmg.jp/my-chemical-romance/news/47049>) (opened).

- **2012-05-19.** Hibernian 1 Hearts of Midlothian 5, 2012 The association records the 5–1 final between the Edinburgh rivals. The superlative assessment of the game is not treated as an independently established fact. Evidence: [Scottish Football Association](<https://150.scottishfa.co.uk/classic-moments/the-scottish-cup/hibernian-1-hearts-of-midlothian-5-2012/>) (opened).

- **2012-05-27.** May 27 final score table The result table records Kolkata 192/5 and Chennai 190/3 and a five-wicket win. This portal is not represented as the official BCCI site. The two-time-champion clause was not checked. Evidence: [IPL.com cricket results portal](<https://www.ipl.com/matches/indian-premier-league-112653/kolkata-knight-riders-vs-chennai-super-kings-40607/stats>) (opened).

- **2012-06-30.** Bug 836803, leap-second symptoms and discussion The primary technical report describes userspace load spikes after the June 30 leap second and related kernel behavior. It does not establish the complete breadth of affected systems in the source assertion. Evidence: [Red Hat Bugzilla](<https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=836803>) (opened).

- **2012-07-02.** February 14, 2013 partnership release, network history The release describes the transformation of HDNet and launch of AXS TV in July 2012. It does not independently establish the exact July 2 date. Evidence: [CBS / AXS TV via PR Newswire](<https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cbs-and-axs-tv-partner-to-enhance-leading-live-events-network-dedicated-to-live-music-and-pop-culture-191256081.html>) (opened).

## January

### 2012-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1187669374](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20January%201&oldid=1187669374>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2012-01-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011–2012 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Arab Inter-parliamentary Union, an advisory body to the Arab League, calls for the removal of its monitors in Syria, saying that they are inadvertently helping the government cover up ongoing violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/01/201211125540595255.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-16379727>).

<a id="event-2012-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011–2012 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian opposition groups say that over 5,800 people were killed in violence in 2011.

### 2012-02-08

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2012-02-08-3-1"></a>

#### Armed conflict and attacks

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-04-16-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon urges "maximum restraint" from the Syrian regime as the first UN military observers arrive in Damascus to monitor a fragile ceasefire.

<a id="event-2012-04-16-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-16-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-16-1-0"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-04-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australia relaxes sanctions on Myanmar, following political reforms in Myanmar, including by-elections earlier this month in which opposition leader Aung San Suu Kyi's party won dozens of seats.

<a id="event-2012-04-16-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military's top officer Martin Dempsey speaks of being "embarrassed" and tells a Pentagon news conference "we let the boss down" in relation to allegations that United States Secret Service agents habitually associated with prostitutes in Colombia. #### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-04-17-0-4"></a>

Thousands of people rally in towns and cities in both the West Bank and the Gaza Strip in support of their action, waving Palestinian flags and displaying photos of imprisoned relatives.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-04-19-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Irish comedian Dylan Moran becomes the first professional English-speaking comedian ever to perform in Russia. The routine references Russia's new law banning "homosexual propaganda" and jailed oil tycoon Mikhail Khodorkovsky.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-17771847>).

<a id="event-2012-04-19-1-3"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-19-1-4"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-19-5-0"></a>

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-04-19-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In tennis, world number one Novak Djokovic defeats Alexandr Dolgopolov at the 2012 Monte-Carlo Masters in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, hours after his grandfather, who provided refuge for the Djokovic family in his Belgrade apartment during the 1999 NATO bombing raids, dies.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-04-20-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Marcus Robinson, due to have been executed in 2007, is ordered off death row after North Carolina Superior Court Judge Gregory Weeks rules his trial was tainted by racial bias, grounds for cancellation of a death sentence under the state's Racial Justice Act. The judge used controversial statistical evidence of bias to grant the change of sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-17762035>).

### 2012-04-22

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Renewed protests against the regime break out overnight with police firing tear gas and stun grenades at civilians. Chants of "Down with Hamad," calling for the King of Bahrain to be ousted from power, are reported by witnesses.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** King of Bahrain Hamad bin Isa al Khalifa issues a pledge of "reform and reconciliation" ahead of the 2012 Bahrain Grand Prix.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Despite calls for the 2012 Bahrain Grand Prix to be cancelled following the death of a man, the race is staged, under armed guard.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Turnout is reported to be low, though Salman bin Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa, heir apparent to the Bahraini throne, is seen smiling and shaking hands with other spectators at the finish.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Sunday Telegraph's chief foreign correspondent Colin Freeman and his fixer and translator are arrested. Activist Ala'a Shehabi is arrested after reporting the arrest of Colin Freeman. The Guardian reports the arrest of Ala'a Shehabi.

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Calls for afternoon protests at the destroyed Pearl Roundabout, the original site of the uprising against the ruling Al Khalifa family, get underway as the race ends, while protests are also held outside the London offices of Formula One chief, Bernie Ecclestone, with demonstrators chanting "down, down Bernie" and "shame on you Bernie".

<a id="event-2012-04-22-0-8"></a>

### 2012-04-23

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-04-23-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and hundreds of others injured in clashes between police and protestors during a nationwide strike in Bangladesh, which was triggered by the unexplained disappearance of opposition politician Ilyas Ali.

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Bahraini uprising: Bahrain's highest appeals court postpones for a week the final verdict in the case of imprisoned hunger striker Abdulhadi al-Khawaja and 20 other democracy activists.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-04-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A festival of William Shakespeare's 37 plays performed polyglotically, from Swahili to sign language, begins as part of the World Shakespeare Festival on the anniversary of the Bard of Avon's birth.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian actor Tiago Klimeck dies at the age of 27 after accidentally hanging himself while playing Judas in an Easter Passion play performed in Itararé, São Paulo.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-23-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kazakhstan issues an official ‘thank you’ to Sacha Baron Cohen for his comedy character Borat Sagdiyev despite an initial ban.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-2-2"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-23-2-3"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Icelandic prime minister Geir Haarde is found not guilty of negligence over the island's 2008 economic meltdown. He is to face no punishment and his legal expenses are to be paid.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17817174>).

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The sister of MI6 officer Gareth Williams, found dead in his flat, tells his inquest that he had been a "scrupulous risk-assessor" and only let "vetted" people into his home.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-17812112>).

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Sky News email hacking:.

**Archived source account.** The British broadcasting regulator Ofcom launches an investigation into the hacking of private email accounts by Sky News.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-4"></a>

Context: Sky News email hacking:.

**Archived source account.** The Ofcom announcement comes on the same day that the news channel's boss John Ryley appears before the Leveson Inquiry where he says the company broke the law by hacking emails.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-17808644>).

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Officials in Florida refuse to allow Bill Lee, the police chief who did not arrest George Zimmerman after he shot and killed unarmed black teenager Trayvon Martin, to resign. George Zimmerman, now facing a murder charge, is released on bail and taken to a secret location.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-17820959>).

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The North Carolina trial of former U.S. Senator and presidential hopeful John Edwards, concerning the use of illegal campaign donations to cover up an affair with a mistress, begins.

<a id="event-2012-04-23-3-7"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-24-3-3"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-26-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-04-26-4-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20120426-hague-court-verdict-liberia-charles-taylor-special-court-sierra-leone-rebels-blood-diamonds?ns_campaign=editorial&amp;ns_source=RSS_public&amp;ns_mchannel=RSS&amp;ns_fee=&amp;ns_linkname=20120426_hague_court_verdict_liberia_charles_taylor&amp;utm_medium>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-17852488>).

<a id="event-2012-04-26-4-5"></a>

<a id="event-2012-05-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones Industrial Average reaches a four-year high due to strong manufacturing figures and company earnings.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2012/05/01/markets/stocks/index.htm?hpt=hp_t3>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people march in Asia, Europe and North America, protesting against job cuts, inequality, and austerity measures.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia-pacific/2012/05/20125110125979907.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/05/02/usa-occupy-may-idUSL1E8G1E0N20120502>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/may/01/may-day-occupy-protests-live?newsfeed=true>); [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/2012/0501/May-Day-Occupy-movement-returns-but-can-it-win-converts>); [MSNBC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120506020553/http://usnews.msnbc.msn.com/_news/2012/05/01/11487362-occupy-protesters-rally-on-may-day-in-new-york-london?lite>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Business/2012-mayday-protests-continue-country-arrests-rain/story?id=16246278#.T6DMvd3X6Go>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** April car sales in Japan rise by 92% year-over-year, a gain partially realized due to low sales in the wake of last year's earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [Kuwait News Agency](<http://www.kuna.net.kw/ArticleDetails.aspx?id=2237642&amp;Language=en>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-05-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama visits Afghanistan on an unannounced visit coinciding with the first anniversary of Osama Bin Laden's assassination by the U.S. Special Forces in Pakistan, signing an agreement with Afghan President Hamid Karzai outlining a continuing U.S. role in Afghanistan after 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-17916489>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five European presidents and the President of the European Commission cancel visits to Ukraine over the treatment of the former prime minister Yulia Tymoshenko.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/ukraine-rebuffed-over-jailed-leader-20120501-1xx3k.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt security services foil an alleged Iranian plot to kill the Saudi ambassador in Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jhZPe68K1-zzK63IcyJqY5taDx3g?docId=CNG.51766c6503bea40d391652f24f6d05ad.421>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese Vice-Premier Li Keqiang visits Moscow. China and Russia sign trade deals worth $15 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Asia Times](<http://www.atimes.com/atimes/China_Business/NE03Cb01.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-05-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** News International phone hacking scandal: The House of Commons Culture, Media and Sport Committee publishes its report into phone hacking at the News of the World. The committee concludes that Rupert Murdoch "is not a fit person" to run a major international company and exhibited "wilful blindness" to phone-hacking and other practices going on in his media empire. The report also accuses three News Corporation executives of giving misleading evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-17898029>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/05/20125110498452985.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New York judge rules that Nafissatou Diallo's civil lawsuit alleging sexual assault by Dominique Strauss-Kahn can proceed to trial.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-17911888>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-05-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tomás Borge, the last surviving founding member of Nicaragua's socialist political party Sandinista National Liberation Front, dies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-17906348>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A parliamentary committee begins work on Turkey's first fully civilian constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17903466>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former opposition leader and foreign minister Tzipi Livni quits the Israeli parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Shanghai Daily](<http://www.shanghaidaily.com/nsp/World/2012/05/02/Exopposition%2Bleader%2Bquits%2Bas%2BIsraeli%2BMP/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-05-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norwegian world swimming champion and Olympic medalist Alexander Dale Oen dies at age 26 after suffering a cardiac arrest during a training camp in Flagstaff, Arizona.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17908737>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenya rugby captain Aberdeen Shikoyi is paid tribute to in death after being injured in a match against Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-17907928>).

<a id="event-2012-05-01-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The sale for Guggenheim Partners to purchase the Los Angeles Dodgers is finalized for US$2.1 billion, the most ever for a professional sports franchise.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN/AP](<http://espn.go.com/los-angeles/mlb/story/_/id/7877983/los-angeles-dodgers-sale-guggenheim-group-finalized>).

### 2012-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076387687](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20May%202&oldid=1076387687>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people are killed in Cairo as unidentified attackers unleash rocks, clubs, firebombs and shotguns on a protest near the Egyptian Ministry of Defence. Police and the military intervene after six hours.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-17920053>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** The New York-based Human Rights Watch accuses Syrian forces of continuing their killing sprees in opposition areas even after peace talks began.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/05/20125292646304502.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2012 South Sudan–Sudan border conflict: The United Nations Security Council passes a resolution threatening sanctions if hostilities do not end within 48 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2012/05/201252153527798597.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least six people are killed in a suicide bombing attack on a Kabul suburb popular with westerners.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/05/02/us-afghanistan-kabul-blast-idUSBRE84102520120502>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War:.

**Archived source account.** A gunfight between the Mexican Army and suspected gunmen of a drug cartel left 12 dead in the western state of Sinaloa, the homestate of Joaquín Guzmán Loera, Mexico's most-wanted drug lord.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-17932666>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-05-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Imprisoned journalist and blogger Eskinder Nega is awarded the PEN America's "Freedom to Write" annual prize for publishing articles critical of Ethiopia's human rights record.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-17921950>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Edvard Munch's The Scream sells for a record $US119,922,500 in an auction in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-business/munchs-the-scream-sold-for-record-120m-20120503-1y0ae.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-05-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in the German city of Mannheim rules that Microsoft has infringed Motorola Mobility's patents and bans Xbox 360 gaming consoles and Windows 7 operating system from sale in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/court-bans-microsoft-products-german-market-083739330--sector.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The News Corporation board expresses its "full confidence" in Rupert Murdoch following a UK government media committee's conclusion yesterday that Murdoch is "not a fit person" to run a major international business.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-17932195>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-05-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Visit to China by Hillary Clinton:.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Hillary Clinton arrives in Beijing for high-level talks with the government of China. She also contacts dissident Chen Guangcheng.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/47249786>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Visit to China by Hillary Clinton:.

**Archived source account.** Chen later leaves the U.S. embassy after a week spent there after fleeing house arrest in China, after alleged threats to his family.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-17920910>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/china/2012-05/02/c_131564088.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese Vice-Premier Li Keqiang travels to Budapest and holds talks with Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.

Source citations (as archived): [China Daily](<http://usa.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2012-05/02/content_15183722.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Japanese owner is found of a Harley-Davidson that drifted to Canada in a container that had been swept out to sea in the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-17927045>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-05-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Coroner Fiona Wilcox states that Secret Intelligence Service officer Gareth Williams was "on the balance of probabilities" unlawfully killed and that it is unlikely he found his way all by himself into the padlocked red sports bag in which his body was found in the bath at his home.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-17922388>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man, believed by the media (but not confirmed) to be J. T. Ready, a Neo-Nazi, and a member of the Minutemen Civil Defense Corps, is among five individuals in Gilbert, Arizona, found dead with gunshot wounds. It is unclear what role he may have played in the apparent shootings, and what precise type they were, but he is believed to have shot the others and then himself in a possible murder-suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120503215328/http://usnews.msnbc.msn.com/_news/2012/05/02/11507220-armored-gunman-4-people-dead-in-arizona-shooting?lite>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-05-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Egyptian military expresses its willingness to hand over political power on May 24 if an outright winner emerges in the first round of the presidential elections.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/world/20120502/173177130.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Presidential candidates Nicolas Sarkozy and François Hollande go head-to-head in a televised debate in France.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17921348>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian Federal Police launches a formal investigation into allegations that Speaker of the Australian House of Representatives Peter Slipper misused Cabcharges.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/police-to-investigate-peter-slipper-over-his-cabcharge-misuses/story-e6freuy9-1226344416366>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/myanmar-set-to-begin-new-political-era-as-suu-kyi-poised-to-be-sworn-in-to-parliament/2012/05/01/gIQAxGEDvT_story.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia-pacific/2012/05/20125213629935697.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2012 United States presidential election: Newt Gingrich suspends his campaign for the Republican Party nomination. Mitt Romney is declared the presumptive nominee.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-503544_162-57426387-503544/newt-gingrich-suspends-presidential-campaign/>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gujarat MP Prabha Taviad breaks down and weeps in parliament alleging assault by police as she tried to attend a government function.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-17919914>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-05-02-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lionel Messi breaks Gerd Müller's scoring record for a single European football season with a league hat-trick as Barcelona defeat Malaga.

Source citations (as archived): [GOAL](<http://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/3277/la-liga/2012/05/02/3076280/lionel-messi-equals-gerd-mullers-record-of-most-goals-in-a>); [National Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120502230227/http://sports.nationalpost.com/2012/05/02/lionel-messi-makes-history-with-hat-trick-in-barcelona-victory/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/17932028>).

<a id="event-2012-05-02-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fabrice Muamba makes an emotional return to the Reebok Stadium following his collapse on the pitch on 17 March 2012.

**Archived source account.** Former National Football League All-Pro and Pro Bowl linebacker Junior Seau is found dead in his home in Oceanside, California, of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound.

#### Armed conflict and attacks

**Archived source account.** Thirty-four people are killed in raids by gunmen opposed to the burning of a colleague at a cattle market in northern Nigeria.

<a id="event-2012-05-03-0-3"></a>

#### Armed conflict and attacks

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and at least 373 others are wounded when armed forces fire water cannon, tear gas and rocks on demonstrators near Egypt's defence ministry in Cairo.

<a id="event-2012-05-04-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Official figures indicate that at least 144 people were injured at an Armenian government campaign event in Yerevan's central square after an explosion during a political rally.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-17964976>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/05/20125418222806654.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-04-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eleven people are killed in a suicide bombing attack in a crowded market in Pakistan's Bajaur Agency.,

<a id="event-2012-05-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** 23 bodies—14 of them decapitated and 9 of them hanged from a bridge—are found in the Mexican city of Nuevo Laredo; those killed were reportedly members of the Gulf Cartel who were killed by Los Zetas, a rival cartel.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/nine-bodies-hung-bridge-northern-mexico-174942376.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Three journalists are killed and their bodies dumped in plastic bags in a canal in Boca del Río in the Mexican state of Veracruz, where the rival criminal groups of Los Zetas and the Gulf Cartel are fighting for territorial control.

Source citations (as archived): [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/huff-wires/20120504/lt-mexico-journalist-killing/>); [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/news/houston-texas/article/More-journalists-murdered-in-Mexico-3533501.php>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-05-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Adam Yauch, founding member of the influential hip hop group the Beastie Boys, dies aged 47.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-17963855>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2012-05-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new study published in The Lancet finds that up to 90 per cent of school-leavers in Asia's major cities are suffering from myopia, or short-sightedness and that 10 to 20 per cent have high myopia, which can lead to blindness.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia-pacific/2012/05/20125416826870694.html>).

The Mexican authorities believe the massacre is a response by Los Zetas for the 2012 Nuevo Laredo massacres reportedly carried out by Joaquín Guzmán Loera (a.k.a. El Chapo), Mexico's most-wanted drug lord.

#### Armed conflict and attacks

#### Armed conflict and attacks

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-05-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Eurozone debt crisis:.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission states that the combined eurozone economy is likely to contract by 0.3% in 2012, as an ongoing debt crisis and high unemployment continue to wrack the 17 euro-using nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/businessnews/article.aspx?id=749422&amp;vId=>).

<a id="event-2012-05-12-1-2"></a>

Context: Eurozone debt crisis:.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish "Indignants" protest movement celebrates its first anniversary, with at least 100,000 people gathering in Spanish cities to protest against the politicians and bankers widely blamed for the country's economic downturn. Similar protests take place in other world cities, including London, Lisbon, Frankfurt and Tel Aviv, as part of a global day of action.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-18047618>); [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/thousands-march-against-economic-gloom-spain-uk-201911721--business.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/05/201251216214686477.html>); [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052702304070304577400872115209702.html>).

**Archived source account.** Leading European Central Bank policymakers state that crisis-hit Greece may be able to abandon the euro without compromising the wider eurozone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2012/05/12/uk-greece-ecb-idUKBRE84B08S20120512>).

**Archived source account.** Three Boston University students are killed and another five are injured in a minivan crash during a trip to New Zealand.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-05-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China denies that its military has been placed on a war footing amid an ongoing dispute with the Philippines over territorial claims in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-18045383>).

<a id="event-2012-05-12-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians held in Israeli prisons are reportedly close to death, having refused to eat for 74 days. A further 1,600 prisoners have been on hunger strike since 17 April. Leaders of the strikers wait for a response from the Israeli Prison Service to calls for negotiation on issues such as the allowing of family visits for prisoners from Gaza and the ending of the use of extended solitary confinement.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/israel/9259455/Palestinian-prisoners-enter-day-74-of-hunger-strike.html>); [Ha'aretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/palestinian-prisoners-to-continue-hunger-strike-1.429838>).

<a id="event-2012-05-12-3-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/05/12/world/meast/iran-ahmadinejad-israel/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-05-12-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-05-12-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of Greece, Karolos Papoulias, begins efforts at forming a coalition government, after three failed attempts by major political parties to reach a coalition agreement.

<a id="event-2012-05-12-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Doctors in the United Kingdom agree to stage a day of industrial action on 21 June, the first such action by the British medical profession since 1975. The strike will lead to cancellations of routine medical appointments, but will not affect emergency care.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-18254499>).

<a id="event-2012-05-30-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Lesotho, Pakalitha Mosisili, resigns after his Democratic Congress party failed to win a majority in the recent general election, while opposition parties form a coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/world/article.aspx?id=755888&amp;vId=>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2012-05-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the successful sequencing of the tomato genome, scientists state that tastier and more pesticide-resistant tomato varieties can be engineered for commercial use within five years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-18253577>).

<a id="event-2012-05-30-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists report that supervolcanoes can develop much faster than previously suspected – erupting within just a few hundred years of their formation, instead of tens of thousands of years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-18269593>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2012-05-30-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Viswanathan Anand defeats Boris Gelfand to win the World Chess Championship for the fourth consecutive time, and the fifth time overall.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/2012/may/30/viswanathan-anand-crowned-chess-champion?newsfeed=true>).

<a id="event-2012-05-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Culture Secretary Jeremy Hunt appears at the Leveson Inquiry into media practices in the UK. The inquiry hears that he congratulated James Murdoch on the progress of News Corporation's takeover bid for BSkyB just hours before he was charged with overseeing it, but acted impartially once he took on the role. Prime Minister David Cameron says he will not order an inquiry into Hunt's ministerial conduct.

<a id="event-2012-05-31-4-1"></a>

<a id="event-2012-05-31-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** After four days of negotiations with student leaders, the Quebec government pulls out of talks meant to end a mass student protest against tuition fees. Demonstrations have been ongoing since February 13, with more than 150,000 students on strike.

#### Science

<a id="event-2012-05-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX's unmanned Dragon capsule successfully returns to Earth following its demo mission to the International Space Station, landing intact in the Pacific Ocean. It is later recovered and shipped back to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5grpUD0qIl5L-gNliMHBc-E_S8fiQ?docId=e9dcaf97edc04dc5ae4d586e64552b10>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/tech/science/space/story/2012-05-31/spacex-dragon-capsule-return/55295594/1>); [NASA](<http://www.nasa.gov/exploration/commercial/cargo/spacex_rss_feed_collection_archive_1.html>).

<a id="event-2012-05-31-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers working with the Hubble Space Telescope predict that the Milky Way will collide with the Andromeda Galaxy in four billion years' time.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/science/sciencenow/la-sci-sn-milky-way-andromeda-galaxy-hubble-milkomeda-20120531,0,2464034.story>).

Source citations (as archived): [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/sports/article/NHL-star-Nicklas-Lidstrom-retires-after-20-seasons-3598859.php>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Syrian uprising (2011-present):.

**Archived source account.** Mexican Drug War: Alleged drug traffickers shoot and kill 3 policemen who were on an anti-narcotics operative inside the Mexico City International Airport. Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/3-policemen-shot-death-mexico-city-airport-171218486.html>).

<a id="event-2012-06-25-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2012-06-25-3-1"></a>

Several other senior officials are also seriously injured, including the country's intelligence chief Hisham Bekhtyar.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/ap-syrian-state-media-says-defense-minister-killed-in-suicide-bombing/2012/07/18/gJQANz7AtW_story.html?wpisrc=al_national>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-18882149>).

The PRI denies the claims and retorts that López Obrador is acting out of desperation and irrationality.

#### Environment and health

<a id="event-2012-08-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nuclear regulators from nine countries hold an emergency meeting in Brussels after unusual fissures were detected in the basic steel material of the Doel 3 pressurized water reactor vessel. This vessel type was built by now-defunct Rotterdam Drydocks with Krupp steel in 22 operating reactors worldwide, among which 10 in the US. Two 1 GW Belgian reactors will remain shut down at least until October.

Source citations (as archived): [Belgian Federal Agency for Nuclear Control](<http://www.fanc.fgov.be/GED/00000000/3200/3272.pdf>); [HLN, in Dutch](<http://www.hln.be/hln/nl/6756/Kernenergie/article/detail/1486947/2012/08/16/Doel-3-zal-eind-september-nog-niet-opgestart-worden.dhtml>).

<a id="event-2012-08-16-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** After an outbreak of the mosquito-borne West Nile virus kills at least 17 people, the mayor of Dallas Mike Rawlings declares a state of emergency in the city. This paves the way for aerial spraying of synthetic pyrethroid insecticides from tonight on. Many residents express their concerns over safety and effectiveness; they suggest other preventive methods of mosquito control. Officials said the measures could cost as much as $1.2 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/americas/2012/08/2012815224318379485.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nation/nationnow/la-na-nn-dallas-west-nile-spray-20120816,0,607038.story>); [Dallas News](<http://www.dallasnews.com/news/community-news/dallas/headlines/20120815-aerial-spraying-for-west-nile-to-start-at-10-tonight-in-dallas-park-cities.ece>).

Three New Zealand soldiers are killed in Bamiyan, central Afghanistan when the convoy in which they were traveling was hit by an improvised explosive device.

### 2012-08-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1255122430](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20August%2020&oldid=1255122430>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2012-08-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** United Nations observers leave the country as their mandate expires. The total number of casualties over the previous weekend is now estimated at more than 100 deaths. The UN envoy describes the conflict as a civil war. Russia says only the UN should decide on force against Syria. The U.S. claims it has "contingency plans" and threatens to change its "calculus" if it finds Syria moving or using chemical or biological weapons. Fighting continues. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

### 2012-08-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-08-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A Chinese state news commentary on recent U.S. "red line" remarks states that, once again, Western powers are digging deep for excuses to intervene militarily in another conflict-torn Middle East country. It sharply denounces the U.S.' "calculus".

<a id="event-2012-08-23-1-0"></a>

Also, something in the environment may trigger the disease.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/new-immune-system-disease-found-in-asians-causes-aids-like-symptoms-in-people-without-hiv/2012/08/22/e1b7eeee-ec95-11e1-866f-60a00f604425_story.html>); [The Voice of Russia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120825060550/http://english.ruvr.ru/2012_08_23/New-AIDS-like-mystery-disease/>).

<a id="event-2012-08-23-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [HLN](<http://www.hln.be/hln/nl/2661/Dieren/article/detail/1490135/2012/08/23/Haai-keert-terug-in-Waddenzee.dhtml>); [Waddenvereniging, in Dutch](<http://www.waddenvereniging.nl/nieuws/item.php?item_id=6459>).

<a id="event-2012-09-01-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2012-09-01-0-5"></a>

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-09-05-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Encyclopedia of DNA Elements is published. For the first time, a, overview of the four million regulatory regions, or functional elements of the human genome found up to now, is made available to the general public. At least 80% of the human genome is biologically active, rather than mainly junk DNA as once believed.

Source citations (as archived): [browsable](<http://www.nature.com/encode/>); [analysable](<http://encodeproject.org/ENCODE/analysis.html>); [ENCODE](<https://archive.is/20121209133547/http://encodeproject.org/ENCODE/>); [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/news/encode-the-human-encyclopaedia-1.11312>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-09-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Clinton notifies Congress of her intent to include the Haqqani network on the government's terror list. An attaché at the Embassy of Pakistan in Washington dismisses the decision as an "internal matter" of the United States and reaffirms Pakistan's commitment to "combating extremism and terrorism." Haqqani senior commanders say the decision will not help in bringing peace to Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/09/07/world/asia/pakistan-us-haqqani/index.html>); [Dawn](<http://dawn.com/2012/09/07/haqqanis-say-us-listing-will-hurt-afghan-peace/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-07-3-2"></a>

Context: Canada–Iran relations:.

**Archived source account.** Canada closes its embassy in Iran and orders all Iranian diplomatic staff out of Canada, citing Iran's support for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, Iran's "among the worst" human rights record, its lack of respect for the Vienna conventions, its nuclear program and the security of Canadian diplomatic personnel. It sees Iran as the world's "most significant threat to global peace and security." Minister of foreign affairs Baird says the Canadian government files Iran as a "state sponsor of terrorism" under the Canadian.

Source citations (as archived): [Justice for Victims of Terrorism Act](<http://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/J-2.5/page-1.html>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/story/2012/09/07/pol-baird-canada-iran-embassy.html>); [Communiqué](<http://www.international.gc.ca/media/aff/news-communiques/2012/09/07a.aspx?lang=eng&amp;view=d>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://seattletimes.com/html/nationworld/2019092368_apeuiraneusanctions.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120907064821/http://www.nation.com.pk/pakistan-news-newspaper-daily-english-online/national/07-Sep-2012/save-the-children-staff-asked-to-leave>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2012/sep/05/pakistan-voluntarysector?newsfeed=true>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/olympics/paralympic-sport/9531121/Oscar-Pistorius-storms-to-400m-gold-to-bring-an-end-to-athletics-action-at-the-2012-Paralympics.html>).

### 2012-09-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076379719](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20September%209&oldid=1076379719>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2012-09-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A main water supply pipe serving central Aleppo is allegedly struck by a government air strike. Hundreds of thousands of inhabitants are left without drinking water. The Aleppo governor says "sabotage" damaged "two pumps serving three districts" and repair work is ongoing. Food, cooking gas and electricity are reported to be in short supply.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/09/09/world/middleeast/syria.html?src=mv&amp;ref=world>); [AP](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/story/2012/07/31/syria-aleppo-clash-731.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/world/2012-09/08/c_131836965.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Two car bombs explode near a hospital in Aleppo that was recently turned into an army barracks. At least 17 people are reported killed and more than 40 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/09/09/us-syria-crisis-idUSBRE8860TF20120909>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Russia calls for a government of Syrian unity.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://nz.news.yahoo.com/a/-/world/14793283/battle-rages-in-aleppo-as-russia-urges-syria-unity/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A wave of attacks kill more than 100 people and injure 350 others across Iraq on the day the death sentence against Tariq al-Hashimi is made public.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-202_162-57509025/wave-of-attacks-kills-at-least-44-in-iraq/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Local authorities report that suspected Taliban abduct and then kill six civilians in the Maidan Wardak province of Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Long War Journal](<http://www.khaama.com/taliban-kill-6-abducted-afghan-civilians-in-wardak-province-767/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-09-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nestor Louis Michel calls Rwandan President Paul Kagame a "great leader" ("groot leider"). Kagame has been accused of war crimes during Rwanda's invasion of the DR Congo in 1996, and of having led a subsequent proxy war against the DR Congo by arming the CNDP until January 20, 2009. Congo currently accuses Rwandan defence officials of supporting a new destabilisation of East Congo. Louis Michel urges the international community for "more time" to "objectivate the facts first" before taking any action.

Source citations (as archived): [De Zondag, p. 12-13, in Dutch](<http://makr.roularta.be/3DI/DZ/index.jsp?editie=14011>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Closing their annual summit, APEC leaders report progress in Vladivostok over environmental and trade barrier issues; some territorial issues remain unsolved.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10000872396390444554704577641301712512154.html?mod=googlenews_wsj>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-09-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Central Criminal Court of Iraq sentences in absentia Vice president of Iraq Tariq al-Hashimi and his aide Ahmed Qahtan to death by hanging for, among other charges, the assassination of a lawyer and that of an Army general.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/09/09/world/meast/iraq-vp-death-sentence/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The son of convicted Romanian former Minister of Agriculture:ro:Ioan Avram Mureșan, Dan Mureșan, is found dead in a Kenyan hotel room. The 32-year-old political manager worked in Kenya for a British company.

Source citations (as archived): [Bucharest Herald](<http://www.bucharestherald.com/dailyevents/41-dailyevents/36738--son-of-ex-minister-ioan-avram-muresan-dies-in-kenya-hotel->); [HotNews.ro](<http://translate.google.com/translate?sl=ro&amp;tl=en&amp;js=n&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;layout=2&amp;eotf=1&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hotnews.ro%2Fstiri-esential-13189518-fiul-fostului-ministru-ioan-avram-muresan-murit-subit-intr-hotel-din-kenya.htm&amp;act=url>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Diplomatic tensions arise over Wednesday's "hit squad" Annecy murders. French investigators may or may not question Saad al-Hilli's colleagues at Surrey Satellite Technology Ltd, or SSTL, near Guildford. A British security source suggests as motive "state-sponsored assassination, rather than a family dispute".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/editorials/leading-articke-discord-will-not-help-solve-this-case-8120659.html>); [Het Laatste Nieuws](<http://translate.google.com/translate?sl=nl&amp;tl=en&amp;js=n&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;layout=2&amp;eotf=1&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hln.be%2Fhln%2Fnl%2F960%2FBuitenland%2Farticle%2Fdetail%2F1497940%2F2012%2F09%2F09%2FWaren-moordenaars-Annecy-uit-op-geheime-militaire-technologie.dhtml&amp;act=url>); [The Week](<http://www.theweek.co.uk/crime/annecy-shootings/48900/annecy-murders-%E2%80%98were-political-assassination%E2%80%99-hit-squad>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Serbia says it protects a witness of organ harvesting on Serbian prisoners of the Kosovo War.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/serbia-says-it-has-testimony-from-witness-of-organ-harvesting-linked-to-kosovo-war/2012/09/09/276d61b0-fab7-11e1-a65a-d6e62f9f2a5a_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-09-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elections for the 70-member Legislative Council are held in Hong Kong. Forty seats are elected by direct popular vote, the remainder are attributed by the "functional constituencies": business and special interest groups. China has promised a fully popular vote by the year 2020; the roadmap is still being laid out.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-19529867>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/china/2012-09/09/c_131837151.htm>); [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2012/09/10/news/foreign/hong-kong-votes-in-crucial-legislative-polls/>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/hong-kong-votes-in-key-elections-that-will-help-shape-future-democracy-plans/2012/09/09/fe3b2b0c-fa47-11e1-a0a1-b07778c66e04_story.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of Japanese people demonstrate for the closure of Futenma airbase (MCAS) in crowded Ginowan, Okinawa. They also protest the deployment of twelve MV-22 Osprey aircraft. They consider the plane as the "most dangerous" in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Advertiser](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121011091745/http://www.staradvertiser.com/news/breaking/169096206.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iVcf0cFwB0OrH0HIjjsjaiFj7_vg?docId=CNG.7ad0ee28009ec5d851cc625daf0045e6.d71>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Armenia, led by world number two Levon Aronian, wins a cliffhanger 40th FIDE Chess Olympiad held in Istanbul, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Tournament's official website](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120908021249/http://results.chessolympiadistanbul.com/tnr77681.aspx?art=0&amp;lan=1&amp;flag=30>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cyclist Alberto Contador confirms his victory in this year's Vuelta a España.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://sports.yahoo.com/news/menchov-wins-20th-leg-contador-163028399--spt.html>); [VeloNews](<http://velonews.competitor.com/2012/09/news/alberto-contador-wins-2012-vuelta-a-espana-as-john-degenkolb-wins-finale_238006>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American tennis player Serena Williams wins her fourth Women's Singles at the US Open.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/tennis/19531577>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belgian Eddy Merckx becomes three-cushion billiards UMB world champion for the second time in his career, succeeding Netherlands' Dick Jaspers.

Source citations (as archived): [Algemeen Dagblad](<http://translate.google.com/translate?sl=fr&amp;tl=en&amp;js=n&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;layout=2&amp;eotf=1&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ad.nl%2Fad%2Fnl%2F1021%2FMeer-sport%2Farticle%2Fdetail%2F3313580%2F2012%2F09%2F09%2FEddy-Merckx-volgt-Jaspers-op-als-wereldkampioen-driebanden.dhtml&amp;act=url>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Antonio Cairoli and Jeffrey Herlings win, respectively, the MX1 and MX2 FIM motocross world championship titles. Cairoli is third in all-time rankings.

Source citations (as archived): [CycleNews](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120919234446/http://cyclenews.com/articles/supercross_motocross/2012/09/09/cairoli-herlings-clinch-world-motocross-titles/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The fourteenth Summer Paralympics end with a display of fireworks. The next rendez-vous is in September 2016, in Rio de Janeiro.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/2012/sep/09/london-2012-paralympics-closing-ceremony-live>).

<a id="event-2012-09-09-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** in hurling, Galway and Kilkenny draw in the 2012 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final. It is the first draw in the hurling final since 1959, and will lead to a replay on September 30.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/hurling/2012/0909/336921-galway-earn-replay-against-kilkenny/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-09-09-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indian space agency puts into orbit its heaviest foreign satellite yet, in a streak of 21 consecutive successful PLSV launches.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/India-news/AndhraPradesh/ISRO-scores-on-100th-mission-PSLV-rocket-launch-successful/Article1-926906.aspx>).

### 2012-09-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076379670](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20September%2010&oldid=1076379670>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2012-09-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War:.

**Archived source account.** Mexican police officers discover 16 corpses with signs of torture inside a vehicle in the southern state of Guerrero.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2012/09/10/mexico-drugs-idINL1E8KAGN720120910>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yemeni officials report that Said al Shihri, the second-in-command of Al Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP), is killed in southern Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19547768>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Kunduz, Afghanistan, kills at least 16 people; a local doctor says "21 or more".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.thefinancialexpress-bd.com/more.php?news_id=142996&amp;date=2012-09-11>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-19543786>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-09-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An agreement is reached allowing the completion of the US National September 11 Memorial &amp; Museum on the World Trade Center site in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [Seattle PI](<http://www.seattlepi.com/news/article/Agreement-reached-for-Sept-11-museum-s-completion-3854471.php>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-09-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Teachers in Chicago go on strike. Around 350,000 students are affected.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-201_162-57509202/chicago-teachers-to-go-on-strike/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/09/10/us-usa-chicago-schools-idUSBRE8870DL20120910>); [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/breaking/chi-chicago-public-schools-chicago-teachers-union-contract-talks-strike,0,2062807.story>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 10,000 South African miners demonstrate at the Lonmin mines in Marikana (Rooikoppies), Rustenburg, Bojanala Platinum district, North West province. Fifteen thousand miners strike at the Gold Fields KDC West Driefontein mine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/gold-fields-says-15-000-workers-strike-south-072621266--finance.html?_esi=1>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2012-09-10-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods and landslides caused by heavy rain kill at least 29 people in northern and central Vietnam.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.seattlepi.com/news/article/Landslides-flooding-kill-29-in-Vietnam-3852032.php>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hurricane and tropical storm warnings are issued for parts of the Canadian province Newfoundland and Labrador as Tropical Storm Leslie approaches.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Centre](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCUAT2+shtml/100547.shtml>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and several others seriously injured after a coach taking people home from the Isle of Wight-based music festival, Bestival 2012 crashes in Surrey, England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-surrey-18976092>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2012-09-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new United States national strategy to prevent suicides is to be released by the Surgeon General, the Secretary of Health and Human Services and the Army Secretary. It will include, among others, the use of social medium Facebook as a tactic.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120911072620/http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/sns-rt-us-usa-health-suicidebre8890o7-20120910,0,2108594.story>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-09-10-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yukiya Amano, the head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), urges Iran to grant IAEA inspectors immediate access to its contentious suspected nuclear facility in Parchin.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/world/20120910/175878630.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Japanese government announces it will soon buy the disputed Senkaku Islands claimed by China (as Diaoyu Islands) and Taiwan (as Tiaoyutai Islands). Chinese leaders respond angrily.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journals](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10000872396390443921504577643261139002438.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/09/10/us-china-japan-idUSBRE8890AU20120910>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Steering Group for Kosovo formally ends its supervision of the partially recognised Republic of Kosovo.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/world/20120910/175884680.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-09-10-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three boys aged eight and nine are killed when a bazooka grenade, left over from a war in Cambodia, explodes. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/boys-die-break-rocket-cambodia-17198523#.UE2SFlGZh8E>); [Jane's](<http://articles.janes.com/articles/Janes-Infantry-Weapons/PG-2-40-mm-High-Explosive-Anti-Tank-HEAT-round-Russian-Federation.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tariq al-Hashimi rejects the charges leading to his death sentence in Baghdad on Sunday. He, being a Sunni, claims to be a "target" of Shiite prime minister Nouri al-Maliki. He refuses to return to Iraq for an appeal as long as, according to him, the judicial system is "corrupt". He claims to put the verdict "on his chest as a medal". Al-Qaeda says "black days" are ahead. The reaction of Iraqi people on the street generally welcomes a fair rule of law but is wary of political influencing and sectarianism.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120913151226/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraq-gunmen-kill-anti-al-qaida-fighters-17198671#.UE3z91GZh8E>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2012/09/10/iraqis-react-to-hashemi-death-sentence/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to a parliamentary answer by the ministry of health, the value of a life lost during a clinical trial is 2.2 lakh rupees ($ 4,000) in India in 2011. This number is the average compensation paid for deaths during clinical trials. No rules governing compensations for clinical trial-related injury or death have been approved by the Parliament of India yet. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [IRNA](<http://old.irna.ir/News/General/Value-of-life-only-rs-2-2-lakh-in-India,-report/80316807>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-09-10-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of the new Somali Parliament elect Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud President.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19540325>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-7-2"></a>

Context: Hong Kong legislative election, 2012:.

**Archived source account.** Voice of America says official results for the 35 "geographical" seats in Hong Kong's legislative elections show 18 seats for the "pan-democracy" camp, 16 seats for the "pro-Beijing" camp and one seat for an independent candidate. The "super" seats show a 3 to 2 win for the pan-democrats. Voter turnout was 53 %, up from 45 % at the previous election in 2008. Reuters says support is "steady" for pro-Beijing chief executive Leung Chun-ying. The New York Times says that, despite winning more votes, the pro-democracy camp has fewer seats than expected. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120910120835/http://www.voanews.com/content/hong-kong-pro-democracy-camp-takes-narrow-lead-in-election/1504684.html>); [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/article/1033062/live-coverage-both-camps-make-early-gains-results-come>); [Reuters](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/sns-rt-us-hongkong-electionbre889007-20120909,0,6482246.story>); [Reuters](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/7646260/Support-steady-for-Beijing-backed-leader>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/09/10/world/asia/hong-kong-voting-for-legislature-is-heavy.html?pagewanted=all>); [results](<http://www.elections.gov.hk/legco2012/eng/rs_gc.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-7-3"></a>

Context: Hong Kong legislative election, 2012:.

**Archived source account.** The chairman of the Democratic Party in Hong Kong, Albert Ho, apologises and says he will resign due to the election result.

Source citations (as archived): [(The Standard)'](<http://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking_news_detail.asp?id=24758&amp;icid=3&amp;d_str=>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chairman Justice Markandey Katju of the Press Council of India, defends Aseem Trivedi: "he did nothing illegal". Since September 9th, the Indian cartoonist Aseem Trivedi is detained in Mumbai on charges of sedition related to the content of his work.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Asia-South-Central/2012/0910/Indian-artist-jailed-for-anticorruption-cartoons>); [First Post](<http://www.firstpost.com/india/cartoonist-sent-to-judicial-custody-on-sedition-charges-449214.html>); [Indian Express](<http://www.indianexpress.com/news/arrest-of-cartoonist-aseem-trivedi-a-crime-katju/1000413/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-10-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In lawn tennis, Andy Murray of the United Kingdom wins the Men's Singles of the 2012 US Open defeating Novak Djokovic of Serbia to become the first British player to win a Grand Slam singles title since Virginia Wade, and the first British man to do so since Fred Perry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Roar](<http://www.theroar.com.au/2012/09/11/murray-downs-djokovic-to-win-us-open/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/tennis/andy-murray-caps-superb-summer-of-british-sport-with-stunning-us-open-triumph-8122478.html>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car bomb targeting Yemen's defence minister, Mohammed Nasser Ahmed, kills at least twelve people, including seven bodyguards of the minister and five civilians in Sana.

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Somalia, more than fifty Al-Shabaab fighters are killed as African Union Kenyan peacekeepers, and the Somali National Army, continue their march towards the port city of Kismayo.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/world/2012-09/11/c_123702733.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021):.

**Archived source account.** Taliban bombard Bagram Air Base. They kill three people and destroy a helicopter, wounding three personnel on board.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/story/2012/09/11/attack-on-us-base-kills-3-afghans-destroys-nato-copter/57746250/1>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021):.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Herat province kills six people including the bomber.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/story/2012/09/11/attack-on-us-base-kills-3-afghans-destroys-nato-copter/57746250/1>); [Dawn](<http://dawn.com/2012/09/11/suicide-bomb-blast-kills-five-afghans-officials/>); [Khaama](<http://www.khaama.com/suicide-bomb-blast-in-herat-local-police-commander-killed-213/>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2012-09-11-0-6"></a>

Christopher Stevens, and three other people are killed. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-09-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Newly declassified documents confirm that the United States deliberately ignored Soviet involvement in the 1940 Katyn massacre, despite credible evidence to the contrary provided no later than 1943. While until 1945 this choice could be explained as World War II grand strategy, it is not known why the White House remained silent on the matter until now.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/katyn-massacre-hushed-stalin-slaughter-polish-officers-released-memos-show-article-1.1156361>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A White House spokesperson says that a Presidential executive order is being considered to ensure the United States' cybersecurity if Congress remains deadlocked over a "CISPA" law.

Source citations (as archived): [Russia Today](<http://rt.com/usa/news/white-house-cispa-order-821/>); [Federal News Radio](<http://www.federalnewsradio.com/241/3026867/White-House-draft-cyber-order-promotes-voluntary-critical-infrastructure-protections->).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sources tell the Frankfurter Allgemeine newspaper that the German military spying agency MAD tried to recruit Uwe Mundlos in 1995. Mundlos refused to cooperate and subsequently participated in ten terrorist murders with the nazi group NSU. He died in 2011; police say he committed suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung](<http://translate.google.com/translate?sl=de&amp;tl=en&amp;js=n&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;layout=2&amp;eotf=1&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.faz.net%2Faktuell%2Fpolitik%2Finland%2Fnsu-rechtsterrorismus-geheimdienst-mad-wollte-wohl-mundlos-anwerben-11886340.html&amp;act=url>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt presses formal charges against Gamel and Alaa Mubarak, sons of ousted president Hosni Mubarak, and Ahmed Shafiq, a recent presidential candidate, over alleged illegal acquisition of land. An arrest warrant has been issued against Shafiq, now a resident in the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily](<http://thedailynewsegypt.com/2012/09/11/ex-presidential-candidate-ahmed-shafiq-a-fugitive/>).

#### Politics and elections

**Archived source account.** The United States commemorates the victims of the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001. For the first time, no special security alert is raised on the anniversary of the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-201_162-57510117/this-years-9-11-commemoration-a-turning-point/>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nation/nationnow/la-na-nn-9-11-anniversary-20120911,0,6720322.story>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Barcelona's streets are paralyzed as protesters peacefully demand independence on the National Day of Catalonia. Police say the demonstrators numbered 1.5 million; organizers estimate the numbers at 2 million. No incidences of violence are reported. The protest is the largest in Catalonia's history.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<http://ccaa.elpais.com/ccaa/2012/09/11/catalunya/1347375808_419590.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-19564640>); [El Punt](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120922004203/http://www.elpuntavui.cat/component/elpunt/article/-/-/575296.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-11-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protestors in Cairo condemn a film promoted by controversial American pastor Terry Jones as a "humiliation of Muhammad under the pretext of freedom of speech". They climb over the walls of the US Embassy and tear down an American flag, replacing it with a black flag inscribed with Islamic emblems. Egyptian police have surrounded the compound to block further incursions.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/09/11/world/meast/egpyt-us-embassy-protests/index.html?hpt=hp_t1>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19562688>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/international/archive/2012/09/the-movie-so-offensive-that-egyptians-just-stormed-the-us-embassy-over-it/262225/>); [Ahram](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/0/52567/Egypt/0/Egypt-army-intervenes-to-pacify-Salafist-protest-a.aspx>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-09-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch general election of 2012, voters in the Netherlands elect new representation in the House of Representatives. The final prognosis shows 41 (+10) seats for incumbent Prime Minister Mark Rutte's People's Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and 40 seats (+10) for PvdA, Diederik Samsom's Labour Party, out of a total 150 seats. Four other parties get between 12 and 15 seats: SP 15 (0), PVV 13 (-11), CDA 13 (-8), and D66 12 (+2) The remainder, 16 seats, are divided among five more parties. The final televised debate is cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/dutch-election-could-change-countrys-allegiances-in-eu-efforts-to-resolve-debt-crisis/2012/09/12/c077d5d4-fc97-11e1-98c6-ec0a0a93f8eb_story.html>); [NOS](<http://translate.google.com/translate?sl=nl&amp;tl=en&amp;js=n&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;layout=2&amp;eotf=1&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fnos.nl%2Fliveblog%2F417626-live-de-verkiezingen-2012.html>); [ANP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120913032145/http://www.google.nl/elections/ed/nl/results>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-09-12-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc unveils iPhone 5 and iOS 6.
