<a id="event-2012-09-12-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new species of guenon monkey discovered in 2007 is now identified in Opala, DR Congo. Local inhabitants call it "lesula". The first specimen resembled the owl-faced monkey, but of unseen colour. More specimen have been located in a 6,500 square mile area. The species' genetic and anatomical distinctiveness (identification) has been determined in a study made the following three years. Its scientific name is Cercopithecus lomamiensis. The publication already recommends it to the Red List of endangered species and proposes conservation measures for its Lomami and central Congo Basin habitat.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://www.bbc.co.uk/nature/19556915>); [Eurekalert](<http://www.eurekalert.org/pub_releases/2012-09/plos-nam091012.php>); [PLoS ONE](<http://www.plosone.org/article/info:doi/10.1371/journal.pone.0044271>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-09-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Reserve System starts a new campaign of increasing the money supply, the expected so-called QE3. But it says it buys mortgage-backed securities in an "open-ended" way, essentially "creating" 40 billion US$ each month. The Fed also considers other measures in a bid to stimulate the economy.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/09/14/business/economy/fed-announces-new-round-of-bond-buying-to-spur-growth.html?_r=1&amp;pagewanted=all>); [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/business/bloomberg/article/Fed-Undertakes-QE3-With-40-Billion-in-MBS-3863144.php>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2012-09-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2012 diplomatic missions attacks:.

**Archived source account.** Protestors breach the walls of the U.S. embassy compound in Sana'a, Yemen. Yemeni police fire warning shots in the air and four people are killed. The Egyptian ministry of health says 224 people are injured in demonstrations around the embassy in Cairo. In Kuwait, 500 people gather and chant near the embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19584734>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5id7YYC1GLslCf7ZvMhqVz5S9b5wg?docId=CNG.fca805b1df739dff1339acedb5926c31.161>).

<a id="event-2012-09-13-4-2"></a>

Context: 2012 diplomatic missions attacks:.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. deploys destroyers and surveillance drones to Libya to hunt for those responsible for the attack in Benghazi. U.S. officials say they are investigating whether the protests over a film privately produced in the US denigrating the prophet Muhammad were used as a cover by the attackers, rather than being spurred by them. The Libyan Deputy Interior minister says there were two parts in the attack - the second attack was on the safe house of which the location was previously leaked. \{\{Dead link\|date=July 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/09/13/world/africa/libya-us-ambassador-killed/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>); [AP](<http://www.detroitnews.com/article/20120913/NATION/209130453/1361/Libya-says-attacks-a-2-part-militant-assault>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-09-14-0-1"></a>

Context: 2012 Anti-Islam film protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters angered by an anti-Islamic film denigrating the Prophet Muhammad attack the German and British embassies in the Sudanese capital of Khartoum. In Khartoum, Tunis and Cairo, at least seven people die. An Egyptian fruit seller dies by rubber bullets.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19602177>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-19608561>); [Egypt Independent](<http://www.egyptindependent.com/news/man-died-embassy-clashes-uneasy-calm-after-protesters-dispersed>).

<a id="event-2012-09-14-0-2"></a>

Context: 2012 Anti-Islam film protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Tripoli, Lebanon, set fire to a KFC and a Hardee's restaurant, sparking clashes with local security forces. One protester is killed and 25 people wounded, including 18 police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19602177>); [AP](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/us-school-ransacked-set-ablaze-near-us-embassy-in-tunis-as-demonstrations-spread/article4544577>).

**Archived source account.** Fifty U.S. Marines are deployed to the American embassy in Yemen as a "precautionary measure" after clashes in the Yemeni capital of Sana'a.

Christopher Stevens, Officer Sean Smith, and former SEALs Tyrone Woods and Glen Doherty, killed in the attack on the American consulate in Benghazi, Libya, are returned to the United States, for their eventual funerals, at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland in a solemn military ceremony attended by President Barack Obama, Vice President Joseph Biden, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and Defense Secretary Leon Panetta.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-09-16-0-2"></a>

The conference calls for a ceasefire and a peaceful political transition to succeed the Assad regime. The armed opposition considers the position as "too lenient on the dictator".

### 2012-09-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1203840535](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20September%2027&oldid=1203840535>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2012-09-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Health voices concerns that the novel coronavirus, similar to SARS and reported to have originated from the country, might affect the Hajj, the religious pilgrimage set to occur next month. The ministry suggests that travelers take the necessary precautions.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Health/Wellness/sars-virus-added-list-hajj-health-risks/story?id=17331279#.UGRAhhHLy5I>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute:.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda meets with UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, explaining to him that the islands are "Japan's inherent territory" and that "there is no territorial dispute as such".

Source citations (as archived): [Yomiuri Shimbun](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120930013915/http://www.yomiuri.co.jp/dy/national/T120927004054.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-2"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute:.

**Archived source account.** Tokyo residents demand that the city's municipal government return private donations it had amassed in order to purchase three of the disputed Senkaku Islands. The central government preempted Tokyo's move by acquiring the islands itself earlier this month. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Mainichi Shimbun](<http://mainichi.jp/english/english/newsselect/news/20120927p2a00m0na004000c.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute:.

**Archived source account.** Japan's Foreign Minister Koichiro Gemba, states that his country intends to reach out to the international community to seek support for its sovereignty over the disputed islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121001003114/http://mainichi.jp/english/english/newsselect/news/20120927p2g00m0dm093000c.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-4"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute:.

**Archived source account.** Jia Qinglin meets with Japanese business leaders and lawmakers in Beijing in a bid to ease tensions between China and Japan. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<http://mainichi.jp/english/english/newsselect/news/20120927p2g00m0dm086000c.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/china/2012-09/27/c_131877673.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-5"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute:.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/world/2012-09/26/c_123766533.htm>); [NHK World](<http://www3.nhk.or.jp/daily/english/20120928_01.html>).

<a id="event-2012-09-27-1-6"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-09-27-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2012-09-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The body of a missing Northwestern University student, a sophomore in the School of Engineering there, is found in Wilmette Harbor on Lake Michigan; police have thus far found no signs of foul play, but his family believes he had been kidnapped and had offered a $25,000 reward.

<a id="event-2012-09-27-2-5"></a>

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-09-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mars Curiosity rover, for the first time, discovers what, upon further study, could be determined to be direct evidence of a fast-moving streambed- a past water source- on the planet, moving from speculation to potential proof of past water, a landmark step because such an area would be a logical site for a future base and for the discovery of past life.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/curiosity-rovers-mars-landing-site-was-once-covered-with-fast-moving-water-nasa-says/2012/09/27/9ce654a0-08d2-11e2-a10c-fa5a255a9258_story.html?hpid=z2>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Bahrain upholds the jail sentences of nine medics convicted for their role in the country's uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/10/01/bahrain-medics-idUSL6E8L14U220121001>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The appeal hearing in the Russian band Pussy Riot's case is delayed after one member of the group fired their lawyer.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/russia/20121001/176332910.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities close down the firm handling dissident artist Ai Weiwei's affairs, possibly saving him from paying the remainder of a 15 million yuan tax fine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/oct/01/ai-weiwei-firm-closed-china>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** California becomes the first U.S. state to forbid "conversion therapy" for minors, effective January 1st, 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2012/09/30/california-to-become-first-state-to-ban-gay-teen-conversion-therapy/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia's president Juan Manuel Santos announces that he has prostate cancer and will undergo surgery on Wednesday. He said his condition is unlikely to derail the upcoming peace talks with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC).

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/colombian-president-prostate-cancer-surgery-000712120.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mikheil Saakashvili's ruling United National Movement party and Bidzina Ivanishvili's new party Georgian Dream are expected to be the main contenders in the Georgian parliamentary elections.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20121001/176322968.html>); [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/stakes-could-not-be-higher-in-georgian-parliamentary-elections/24723413.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Japan, Koriki Jojima is appointed as the new finance minister and Seiji Maehara as the new minister of national strategy and economic policy.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/e4bf5210-0b96-11e2-8e06-00144feabdc0.html#axzz2837rzxq8>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Sarsak turns down an FC Barcelona offer to attend an El Clásico game, after Gilad Shalit, an Israeli soldier who had been held captive in Gaza for five years, is also invited. A Hamas spokesperson asked the media not to broadcast the game.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/Sports/Football/2012/Oct-01/189781-palestinian-footballer-turns-down-barca-invite.ashx#axzz283WCTu42>).

<a id="event-2012-10-01-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mohamed Nasheed, the former president of the Maldives, fails to appear in court and departs on tour for his party. Vice-president Mohammed Waheed Deen, opening an academic conference in Malé, says a nation can achieve democracy by the teachers imparting the relevant information.

Source citations (as archived): [Haveeru](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151015220914/http://www.haveeru.com.mv/news/44856>); [Haveeru](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121113220245/http://www.haveeru.com.mv/news/44854>).

### 2012-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1097634052](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%202&oldid=1097634052>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill at least twenty students at a hostel away from the Federal Polytechnic campus in the northeastern Nigerian town of Mubi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19801814>).

<a id="event-2012-10-02-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A member of the People’s Majlis, the parliament of the Maldives, is found stabbed to death near his home.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-19797538>).

<a id="event-2012-10-02-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb blast in southern Afghanistan kills a United States Army service member.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://latimesblogs.latimes.com/world_now/2012/10/afghanistan-bomb-kills-us-soldier.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-10-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A minibus collides with a truck in the northern Philippine province of Ilocos Norte, killing at least 10 people. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/10-dead-road-collision-northern-philippines-17373411#.UGwCq5jMiMk>).

<a id="event-2012-10-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The number of confirmed deaths in the ferry collision in Hong Kong rises to 38.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-19797588>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2012-10-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A European Commission report draft estimates the investment needed for increasing the safety of Europe's 134 power station nuclear reactors at 10 to 25 billion euro. The full report on the stress tests is to be debated by EU ministers later this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/10/02/eu-nuclear-tests-idUSL6E8L2G0020121002>); [PDF](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121113072140/http://deredactie.be/polopoly_fs/1.1444957!file/stresstest-kerncentrales.pdf>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-10-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. Border Patrol agent is shot dead near the U.S.-Mexico border in the state of Arizona. A second agent was shot and is being treated for non-life threatening injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-19809604>).

<a id="event-2012-10-02-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several sources claim that a French spy killed Muammar Gaddafi in 2011; the motive to try to conceal Ghadaffi's financial support of Nicolas Sarkozy's 2007 presidential election campaign. A French source dismisses the story as "nonsense".

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/Europe/Gaddafi-killed-by-French-agent-on-Sarkozy-order/Article1-938543.aspx>); [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20121001-reports-gaddafi-killed-french-agent-patent-nonsense-france-libya-jibril-el-obeidi>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The OSCE titles the parliamentary election in Georgia as "fair and free". Partial results show a majority of votes for Georgian Dream. President Saakashvili concedes that his party, United National Movement, will move to opposition. Bidzina Ivanishvili is expected to become prime minister, and after legislative changes next year, also head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2012-10-01/georgian-president-saakashvili-suffers-surprise-election-setback>); [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Eccentric-billionaire-likely-to-lead-country-3912125.php>).

### 2012-10-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076377012](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%203&oldid=1076377012>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian refugees in rented houses say the Turkish police in Hatay Province faces them with the choice to either join a refugee camp or go back to Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/10/02/world/meast/syria-refugee-crisis-turkey/index.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A series of bombings at the Saadallah Al-Jabiri Square in the northwestern city of Aleppo kill at least 34 people. The al Qaeda linked Jabhat al-Nusra claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19811829>); [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10000872396390443635404578035822373395226.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Turkish armed forces bombard targets in Syria in response to a Syrian Army shelling that hit the Turkish border town of Akçakale, killing five people.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10000872396390443768804578034372539783626.html#printMode>).

<a id="event-2012-10-03-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several blasts strike an arms stockpile in the Hezbollah-controlled Bekaa Valley in Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/10/201210314222861555.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-03-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Riot police in Iran clash with protestors demonstrating against the collapse of the country's currency, the rial.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/10/2012103113527747494.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-10-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinea recognizes the independence of Kosovo.

Source citations (as archived): [M-Mag](<https://web.archive.org/web/20131010180413/http://www.m-magazine.org/en/Kosovo/Papua-New-Guinea-confirms-recognition-of-Kosovo-3271>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Politicians in the United States begin a probe into the attack on the U.S. Consulate in Benghazi, Libya, on September 11. Walid Faraj, a surviving witness of the attack, has not yet been interrogated.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2012-10-03/libya-attack-probe-unfolds-as-u-s-politicians-pin-blame.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/us-probe-of-libya-attack-moves-slowly-8195359.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/libyans-say-few-questions-being-asked-about-attack/2012/10/02/4398d6e2-0cd9-11e2-ba6c-07bd866eb71a_story.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-03-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of India's poorest farmers march more than 300 kilometers to Delhi in a Jan Satyagraha to demand land reform under the banner of Ekta Parishad.

Source citations (as archived): [Zee News](<http://zeenews.india.com/news/nation/jan-satyagraha-50-000-people-to-march-to-delhi_803390.html>); [Asia One](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121110112423/http://news.asiaone.com/News/AsiaOne%2BNews/Asia/Story/A1Story20121003-375342.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-10-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A few days later than initially planned, ATV-3 burns up; remaining parts plunge in the Pacific Ocean. The next mission docking with ISS, the first commercial resupply mission, with SpaceX Dragon is planned to launch on 8 October at 12:35 AM GMT. Unberthing and splashdown are targeted for 28 October. Orbital Sciences plans two Cygnus dockings to the ISS; in April 2013 follows Albert Einstein ATV (ATV-4). ATV-5 is planned April 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [ESA](<http://blogs.esa.int/atv/>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/science/20121003/176373944.html>); [NASA](<http://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2012/10/europes-atv-3-fiery-plunge-back-atmosphere/>); [Antares](<http://www.orbital.com/Antares/>).

#### Transport

<a id="event-2012-10-03-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The decision to award the rail franchise for the United Kingdom's West Coast Main Line to FirstGroup is scrapped by the government after what are described as "significant technical flaws" in the bidding process.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-19809717>).

### 2012-10-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115476876](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%204&oldid=1115476876>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian–Turkish border clash:.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish parliament approves a motion authorizing cross-border military operations against Syria after Syrian forces shelled the Turkish border town of Akçakale on October 3, killing five people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19830928>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian–Turkish border clash:.

**Archived source account.** Turkish forces continue to bombard Syrian territory for a second day in retaliation for a cross-border strike from Syria that killed five people in Akçakale.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/9588296/World-leaders-urge-Turkey-to-step-back-from-brink-of-war-with-Syria.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian–Turkish border clash:.

**Archived source account.** Syria offers condolences for the shelling deaths in Akçakale; a Turkish official says Syria has offered formal apologies.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-202_162-57525883/turkey-syria-admits-fault-for-deadly-shelling/>); [SANA](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121009211418/http://sana.sy/eng/21/2012/10/04/445137.htm>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters storm the headquarters of the Libyan General National Congress in the capital Tripoli angry at Prime Minister Mustafa Abushagur's proposed cabinet line-up, saying it is not fully representative of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/10/04/us-libya-government-idUSBRE8930RG20121004>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The FBI conducts its investigation into the attack on the U.S. Consulate in Benghazi, Libya, in one day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-19838720>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2012-10-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying and other government officials observe three minutes of silence to mourn the victims of a ferry collision off Lamma Island on October 1, marking the start of a three-day mourning period.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-19824735>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A landslide buries at least 19 people in the southwestern Chinese province of Yunnan with 18 later confirmed dead and one missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-19825402>); [AP](<http://www.sfgate.com/news/article/18-students-die-after-landslide-hits-China-school-3918030.php>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Expelled Ulster Unionist Party member David McNarry, who represents Strangford, joins the UK Independence Party, giving it its first representative in any of the devolved assemblies in Britain and Northern Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2012/1004/breaking61.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An abortion rights activist ship is blocked from entering the Moroccan port of Smir; the vessel is operated by the Dutch non-profit organization Women on Waves, which provides abortions and related medical services to women living in countries with restrictive abortion laws.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2012/10/04/Abortion-ship-barred-from-Moroccan-port/UPI-84641349362065/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Philippine President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo is arrested in hospital on new charges of allegedly misusing state funds while in office.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<http://www.abs-cbnnews.com/nation/10/04/12/arroyo-arrested-plunder-stays-vmmc>).

<a id="event-2012-10-04-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jordan's official news agency announces that King Abdullah dissolves parliament, paving the way for early elections.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19837500>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2012-10-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** GCHQ director Iain Lobban gives a rare public speech in which he speaks of the "enduring lessons" to be drawn from the work of Alan Turing, who reportedly committed suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-19834593>).

**Archived source account.** The 2013 Championship draw is made at GAA headquarters in Croke Park.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-05-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Syrian city of Homs is subjected to a sustained bombing campaign, the worst it has seen in five months.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19845165>).

<a id="event-2012-10-05-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Workers say a miner is killed by a police rubber bullet near Rustenburg. A National Union of Mineworkers branch leader of Lonmin is killed at his house in Marikana, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/1681628-south-african-union-leader-shot-dead-near-lonmin-mine-num/>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFBRE8940CQ20121005?pageNumber=4&amp;virtualBrandChannel=0>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2012-10-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anglo Platinum Limited—the world's biggest platinum producer—fires 12,000 people in South Africa after a strike over working conditions. The corporation has stated that the strikes have cost it 39,000 ounces in output - equivalent to 700 million rand ($82.3 million; £51 million) in revenue.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-19848915>).

<a id="event-2012-10-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 47 people throughout the United States are infected with fungal meningitis from contaminated medicine, with five people dying.

<a id="event-2012-10-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The British High Court rules that Islamist cleric Abu Hamza al-Masri and four other suspected terrorists can be immediately extradited to the United States to face trial on charges of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-19842941>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/10/05/world/europe/uk-abu-hamza-extradition/index.html?hpt=hp_t1>).

<a id="event-2012-10-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A torture case related to the 1950s Mau Mau uprising is allowed to proceed in a British court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-19843719>).

<a id="event-2012-10-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles Police Department fails to obtain a search warrant when a federal judge in Texas blocks their attempt to obtain 1970's tapes of conversations between a Manson family member and his attorney. LA Police believe this evidence could help solve more than a dozen murders.

Source citations (as archived): [FoxNews](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2012/10/19/judge-stops-lapd-warrant-for-manson-follower-tapes>).

Al Hassan was known for being the prime investigator in the Michel Samaha case, where Michel Samaha was caught smuggling bombs into Lebanon upon orders from the Syrian government to kill Lebanese officials between 2005 and 2008, starting with the murder of Rafik al-Hariri.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/10/20121019154940460986.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-19-0-3"></a>

<a id="event-2012-10-19-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tour bus went off the highway and crashed in northwest Arizona late Friday at around 8:00 PM PDT, killing the bus driver (who was believed to have suffered a medical incident), and leaving at least four of the passengers with serious injuries. About 45 other passengers were hurt less seriously, and some were not hospitalized. The bus was northbound on Highway 93 near Willow Beach, Arizona and the Nevada state line, southeast of Las Vegas.

<a id="event-2012-10-19-3-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/10/20/14571413-police-missing-oregon-womans-remains-found-neighbor-arrested?lite>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syrian civil war: UN and Arab League special envoy Lakhdar Brahimi meets with Syrian Foreign Minister Walid Muallem in Damascus in an attempt to push for a temporary ceasefire during next week's Eid al-Adha holiday.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Tripoli announce the capture of Muammar Gaddafi's former spokesman Moussa Ibrahim near the town of Tarhouna, 40 miles south of the capital Tripoli. Ibrahim's whereabouts had been unknown since the end of the civil war in 2011 and there had been several earlier reports of his arrest. Hours later an audio message purported to be by Ibrahim appears online, in which he denies being captured or even being in Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://archive.is/20130416011700/http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/libya-govt-says-former-gaddafi-spokesman-captured/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20016076>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-10-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. former professional road racing cyclist Lance Armstrong is stripped by the International Cycling Union of his seven Tour de France titles and banned for life from participating in UCI-sanctioned events.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/cycling/20008520>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/10/2012102211926646191.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-22-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A football fan is jailed after an attack on former England international goalkeeper Chris Kirkland during a match last week. Twenty-one-year-old Aaron Cawley was filmed on live television jumping from the stand and striking Kirkland with both arms on the head following a goal during the league match at Hillsborough. Kirkland, who described the assault as like being "hit by a ton of bricks", was thrown off balance, crashed to the ground against his goal area and required treatment for his injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2012/oct/22/fan-charged-assault-sheffied-wednesday>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/leeds-united/9625456/Jailed-Leeds-fan-Aaron-Cawley-binged-on-lager-cider-and-vodka-before-attacking-Sheffield-Wednesdays-Chris-Kirkland.html>).

### 2012-10-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219737562](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%2023&oldid=1219737562>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-23-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and two others are wounded in an Israeli artillery attack in the northern Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/10/20121023202632194449.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi insurgency: At least eight people are killed in car bombings and mortar attacks across various districts in Baghdad, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20039632>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A young Pakistani man, whose father was killed by drones alongside 40 others in March 2011, seeks to block the sharing of British intelligence with the CIA. This represents the first serious legal challenge in the English courts to Britain's involvement in the drones campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/oct/23/uk-support-us-drones-pakistan-war-crime>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-10-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Skyfall, the 23rd James Bond film, receives its Royal premiere at London's Royal Albert Hall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-20044627>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The prominent Bengali poet and novelist Sunil Gangopadhyay dies from a heart attack in the West Bengal capital Kolkata.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-20038384>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Mumbai investigate the sudden death last weekend of the renowned Bollywood film-maker Yash Chopra, who was earlier thought to have died from dengue fever.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-20038380>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2012-10-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** European Commissioners debate a proposal to the European Parliament to accept a 40 per cent quota for women on corporate boards.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-20039540>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2012-10-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at a hospital in the southern Taiwanese city of Tainan kills at least 12 people and injures up to 60 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-20038287>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A "very loud explosion" and a "huge fire" at a military factory in Khartoum are being treated as suspicious.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20050781>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following yesterday's conviction of scientists for their failure to predict the 2009 L'Aquila earthquake, Luciano Maiani—head of Italy's disaster body—resigns in protest at the harsh treatment of his colleagues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-20039769>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/10/201210231594456401.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A surfer is killed in southern California following an attack by a great white shark.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-20052152>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/10/23/us/california-shark-attack-death/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

#### Innovation and technology

<a id="event-2012-10-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The analogue TV signal in Northern Ireland is turned off permanently at 23:30 BST, completing the final stage of the UK digital switchover. Ceefax, the world's first teletext information service, is also brought to an end after 38 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-20033934>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-10-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, the Emir of Qatar, visits the Gaza Strip, the first head of state to visit there since Hamas seized control of the territory five years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-20037203>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/10/2012102353137370247.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/oct/23/qatari-emir-welcome-gaza-visit>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/gaza-offers-qatari-ruler-heros-welcome/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-10-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** BBC Director-General George Entwistle appears before the House of Commons Culture, Media and Sport Committee to answer questions about the Corporation's handling of allegations of sexual abuse against Jimmy Savile.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/newsnight-should-have-continued-jimmy-savile-report-directorgeneral-george-entwistle-admits-bbc-culture-over-sexual-exploitation-has-changed-too-little-8222484.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four civil cases are filed against Trinity Mirror, publishers of the UK newspaper the Daily Mirror, over allegations of phone hacking.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2012/oct/23/phone-hacking-allegations-trinity-mirror-shares>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-23-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four third-party U.S. presidential election candidates—representing the Libertarian, Green, Constitution, and Justice parties, who were excluded from the high-profile televised encounters between Mitt Romney or Barack Obama—attend their own presidential debate hosted in Chicago by the Free and Equal Elections Foundation, which hopes for a more transparent and open electoral system. Romney (with the Republican Party) and Obama (with the Democratic Party) refuse invitations to attend the debate, televised on international news channels but on no major U.S. network.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/americas/2012/10/20121023185635673481.html>); [VOR](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121111102441/http://english.ruvr.ru/2012_10_23/Third-party-presidential-debate-presented-by-Russian-TV-channel/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/the-fix/wp/2012/10/23/previewing-the-third-party-presidential-candidates-debate/>); [Press TV](<http://presstv.com/usdetail/268084.html>); [The Sacramento Bee](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121024061753/http://www.sacbee.com/2012/10/22/4929868/rt-to-air-third-party-us-presidential.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese Justice Minister Keishu Tanaka, who took office on October 1, resigns amid a scandal over alleged ties to an organized crime syndicate.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-20037934>).

<a id="event-2012-10-23-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two MSPs – John Finnie and Jean Urquhart – resign from the Scottish National Party over its stance on NATO, effectively reducing the party's absolute majority in the Scottish Parliament to two.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/politics/2012/oct/23/msps-resign-snp-nato-stance>).

### 2012-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1320645582](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%2024&oldid=1320645582>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-24-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Siege of Bani Walid (2012): Militias loyal to the Libyan government capture the town of Bani Walid after days of battle, with locals claiming that 130 civilians have died under artillery shelling attacks from militia forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<http://www.thedailybeast.com/articles/2012/10/24/ex-gaddafi-stronghold-surrenders-to-pro-government-forces.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/10/24/us-libya-clashes-idUSBRE89N0WL20121024>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel targets rocket launching sites in Gaza in response to over 80 rockets being fired into Israeli territory by militants, causing deaths and injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20054554>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/rocket-fire-from-gaza-resumes-after-brief-lull/>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudan blames the explosion at a munition factory south of Khartoum on an Israeli airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2012/10/20121024142531802810.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syrian civil war: The UN peace envoy Lakhdar Brahimi states in Cairo that the Syrian government has agreed to a ceasefire during the four-day Muslim holiday, Eid al-Adha.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/9630086/Syrian-government-agrees-to-four-day-ceasefire.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A journalist based in Somaliland is killed by gunmen while returning home from work.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20066670>).

#### Innovation and technology

<a id="event-2012-10-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The analogue television service in the Republic of Ireland is switched off at 10.00am, hours after Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom as a whole's television service switched off.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2012/1024/digital-switchover-television.html>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/entertainment/tv-radio/analogue-tv-switched-off-amid-lastminute-rush-3270961.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An administrative law judge with the U.S. International Trade Commission issues a preliminary decision on a long-running Samsung/Apple dispute, in favor of Apple's complaint on four of the six patents in dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [ThomsonReuters](<http://newsandinsight.thomsonreuters.com/Legal/News/2012/10_-_October/Trade_panel_judge_says_Samsung_infringed_Apple_patents/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-10-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After years of delays and disputes over cost and design, and amid references in newspapers to Germany's rejection of asylum applications by Roma from Kosovo and comments from the country's interior minister alleging "increasing abuse of asylum from countries in the Balkans", Angela Merkel unveils a memorial near the Reichstag to members of the Roma community killed during the Nazi Holocaust.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-20050780>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sir Norman Bettison resigns as Chief Constable of West Yorkshire Police as his role in the aftermath of the 1989 Hillsborough disaster is being investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-20067716>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a landmark hearing at the Supreme Court of England and Wales, 174 women formerly employed by Birmingham City Council are given permission to seek compensation under Equal Pay legislation for missed bonuses. The ruling extends the time window for such claims from six months to six years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-birmingham-20054049>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/jobs/9629990/Women-win-equal-pay-fight-in-landmark-ruling.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UK's Director of Public Prosecutions is to review a 2009 decision by the Crown Prosecution Service not to prosecute Jimmy Savile over allegations of sexual abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/local-national/uk/bbc-workers-face-sex-claims-probe-16228721.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/crime/jimmy-savile/9630550/Jimmy-Savile-What-George-Entwistle-told-MPs-about-Panorama-justthewomen-Newsnight-and-the-conversation-at-the-Hilton-Hotel.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Société Générale trader Jérôme Kerviel loses his appeal against a five-year prison sentence for forgery and breach of trust, handed down in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-20067510>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former maintenance worker at Creflo Dollar's World Changers Church International in the Atlanta suburb of College Park, Georgia has fatally shot a 39-year-old church volunteer. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/sns-rt-us-usa-shooting-georgiabre89n144-20121024,0,497801.story>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in the Denver suburb of Westminster, Colorado arrest a 17-year-old resident who was allegedly involved in an attempted abduction in the killing of 10-year-old Jessica Ridgeway.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/10/24/14672250-teen-arrested-in-killing-of-jessica-ridgeway-10-year-old-colorado-girl?lite>).

<a id="event-2012-10-24-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are shot dead, two are critically wounded, and a gunman is at large after shootings at two locations in the Los Angeles suburb of Downey, California: a business next to a Coca-Cola plant, and a residence.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/10/24/14674514-manhunt-after-3-shot-dead-2-wounded-in-los-angeles-area?lite>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2012-10-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Welsh government reaches an agreement with the British government giving Wales limited powers to borrow money to finance major projects.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-politics-20049205>).

#### Religion and diplomacy

<a id="event-2012-10-24-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Benedict XVI announces a 24 November 2012 Consistory for the creation of six new Cardinals: James Michael Harvey, Bechara Boutros al-Rahi, Baselios Cleemis, John Olorunfemi Onaiyekan, Jesús Salazar Gómez, and Luis Antonio Tagle.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic Herald](<http://www.catholicherald.co.uk/news/2012/10/24/pope-names-six-new-cardinals/>); [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/indian-among-6-new-cardinals-named-by-pope/article4027832.ece?homepage=true>).

### 2012-10-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1151927944](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%2025&oldid=1151927944>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syrian civil war: The Syrian government announces via its state media that it will suspend military operations from Friday to Monday, during this year's Muslim Eid al-Adha holiday, as part of a ceasefire proposal by U.N. special envoy Lakhdar Brahimi.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/10/25/world/meast/syria-civil-war/index.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2012-10-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Official GDP figures indicate the 2012 Summer Olympics helped the UK economy emerge from recession in the three months from July to September, with growth of 1.0%.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-20078231>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Costa Coffee—the world's second-largest coffeehouse chain—pulls out of Totnes, the Devon town that prides itself on having independent shops.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-devon-20079092>); [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/westcountry/2012-10-25/totnes-businesses-say-no-to-costa/>); [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/2012/10/25/costa-retreats-from-totne_n_2015248.html?utm_hp_ref=uk>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2012-10-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Sandy heads towards The Bahamas after making landfall in Cuba and Jamaica.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/10/25/world/americas/tropical-weather-sandy/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-10-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rape claim against a major Irish celebrity is investigated. The victim was made pregnant during her ordeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/gardai-probe-rape-claim-against-major-celebrity-3271951.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury fails to reach a verdict in the retrial of a policeman thought to have racially abused a suspect in the aftermath of the 2011 England riots.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-20083782>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scotland Yard says that the number of potential victims in the Jimmy Savile sexual abuse scandal has risen to 300.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/crime/jimmy-savile/9633678/Jimmy-Savile-300-victims-400-lines-of-inquiry-130-interviews.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2012/oct/25/jimmy-savile-bbc-director-general>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New York Police Department officer, 6-year employee Gilberto Valle III along with an unnamed co-conspirator, is charged with allegedly conspiring to cross state lines and kidnap, torture, cook, and eat women (at least 100 names and pictures, some with physical descriptions, were found on his computer). He could get up to life in prison. \{\{Dead link\|date=April 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<http://t.news.msn.com/pop-culture/ny-police-officer-charged-with-plan-to-cook-eat-women-1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-10-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amid concerns of voting fraud, U.S. presidential candidate Mitt Romney's campaign is linked to Hart InterCivic a firm providing the voting machines to be used to tally the ballots in the crucial state of Ohio.

Source citations (as archived): [The Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/world-news/us-election/ohio-voting-machines-ndash-brought-to-you-by-the-romneys-16229346.html>); [Salon.com](<http://www.salon.com/2012/10/23/romney_linked_voting_machine_company_to_count_votes_in_ohio/>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** France's interior minister Manuel Valls is embroiled in controversy amid reports he ordered police to clear his Paris neighbourhood of homeless so his wife could go about her shopping "in peace". \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Ottawa Citizen](<https://ottawacitizen.com/news/French+minister+shoos+away+homeless+wife+shop+peace/7442824/story.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Bidzina Ivanishvili and his cabinet are approved by the Parliament of Georgia following the victory in the parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-20081392>).

<a id="event-2012-10-25-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister and Likud chairman Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israeli Foreign Minister and Yisrael Beiteinu chairman Avigdor Lieberman announce the unification of their two parties which will run as a single bloc for the upcoming election to be held in January 2013; the joint party will be called "Likud Beiteinu" ("The Likud Is Our Home") and Netanyahu will be number 1 on the list, followed by Liberman who will be number 2 on the list.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20090316>); [The Jewish Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121027020534/http://www.jewishpress.com/news/breaking-news/likud-and-yisrael-beiteinu-join-forces/2012/10/25/>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-announces-merger-with-israel-beytenu-promises-to-lead-with-strength/>).

#### Religion and diplomacy

<a id="event-2012-10-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bishop Richard Williamson, because of his opposition to dialogue and his Holocaust denial, is expelled from the Society of Saint Pius X (SSPX) by its superior, Bishop Bernard Fellay. The SSPX is a formerly breakaway ultra-conservative Roman Catholic society founded by the late Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre that is critical of many of the changes in the Church brought about by Vatican Council II.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Service](<http://www.catholicnews.com/data/stories/cns/1204487.htm>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2012-10-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Emanuel Steward, International Boxing Hall of Fame inducted trainer, and most notable for training 41 world champion fighters throughout his career, including Lennox Lewis, Wladimir Klitschko, Thomas Hearns, and Tony Tucker, dies at the age of 68.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/boxing/story/_/id/8551612/emanuel-steward-famed-boxing-trainer-dies-68>).

### 2012-10-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076373987](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20October%2026&oldid=1076373987>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-10-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Latest round of sectarian clashes between Buddhists and Rohingya Muslims kill at least 64 people in western Burma; 3,200 Rohingya have been displaced.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/10/26/world/asia/myanmar-unrest/index.html>); [Al-Arabiya](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121027194544/http://english.alarabiya.net/articles/2012/10/27/246133.html>).

<a id="event-2012-10-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Fighting in Syria continues as the ceasefire agreement mediated by U.N. special envoy Lakhdar Brahimi to occur during the Muslim holiday of Eid al-Adha begins.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/terrorism-security/2012/1026/Holiday-cease-fire-in-Syria-pocked-with-bullets>).

<a id="event-2012-10-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb explodes in the capital Damascus, killing an unknown number of people and injuring many.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/10/26/us-syria-crisis-idUSBRE88J0X720121026>).

<a id="event-2012-10-26-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing at a mosque in Maymana, Afghanistan, kills at least 41 people and wounds up to 50 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-20092591>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-10-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Writer Javier Marías rejects the Spanish government's National Novel Prize, awarded for his novel Los enamoramientos, saying "All my life I have managed to avoid state institutions, regardless of which party was in government, and I have turned down all income from the public purse. I don't want to be seen as an author who is favoured by any particular government."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/oct/26/spanish-novelist-turns-down-prize>).

#### Law and crime
