Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/region/iran/iran-to-probe-alleged-death-of-a-jailed-blogger-1.1103119>).

### 2012-11-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1206133389](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2012&oldid=1206133389>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A second mortar shell from Syria has been fired at an Israeli military outpost in the Golan Heights, after a similar incident the day before. The Israel Defence Forces have responded with tank fire at the source of the bombardment, scoring several direct hits on artillery units belonging to the Syrian Army.

Source citations (as archived): [NY Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/13/world/middleeast/israel-strikes-at-syria-again-in-response-to-mortar-attacks.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2012-11-12-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 38 police officers are killed in northern Kenya amid clashes with cattle rustlers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/11/13/world/africa/kenya-ambush/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-11-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Into the Silence by Wade Davis, a biography of George Mallory wins the 2012 Samuel Johnson Prize for Non Fiction.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-20298350>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Muslim cleric Abu Qatada will be released on bail after winning an appeal against deportation from the United Kingdom to Jordan. The UK government says it will appeal against the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-20295754>).

#### Media

<a id="event-2012-11-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Newsnight controversy:.

**Archived source account.** Helen Boaden, the BBC's Director of News, and her deputy Steve Mitchell relinquish their roles in the wake of the Newsnight scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ News](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2012/1112/bbc-newsnight.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-12-3-2"></a>

Context: Newsnight controversy:.

**Archived source account.** Fran Unsworth, head of newsgathering, and Ceri Thomas, the editor of Radio 4's Today are named Acting Director and Deputy Director of News respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [The Scotsman](<http://www.scotsman.com/lifestyle/tv-and-radio/bbc-turmoil-deepens-as-news-director-and-deputy-quit-1-2628301>).

<a id="event-2012-11-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Newsnight controversy:.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron questions the BBC's decision to give former Director-General George Entwistle a year's pay by way of severance after he resigned on Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/politics/2012/nov/12/george-entwistle-bbc-payoff-tough-justify>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2012-11-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sir Rex Hunt, who was Governor of the Falkland Islands at the time of the 1982 invasion dies aged 86.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-20294856>).

#### Physics

<a id="event-2012-11-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2012 EPS Edison Volta Prize was awarded to Rolf-Dieter Heuer, CERN Director General, and two his colleagues.

Source citations (as archived): [EPS](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121118065329/http://www.eps.org/news/108255/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Serbian Novak Djokovic beats Swiss Roger Federer 7-6 (8-6), 7-5 in final to win 2012 ATP World Tour Finals in singles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/tennis/20305610>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/2012/nov/12/roger-federer-novak-djokovic>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/tennis/atptour/9672930/Roger-Federer-v-Novak-Djokovic-ATP-World-Tour-final-live.html>).

### 2012-11-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1152096079](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2013&oldid=1152096079>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Three Syrian tanks have entered the demilitarized zone in the Golan Heights. Israel has launched a formal complaint to the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/three-syrian-tanks-enter-demilitarized-zone-in-golan-heights.premium-1.474080>).

<a id="event-2012-11-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** France and six other states recognize the National Coalition for Syrian Revolutionary and Opposition Forces as the legitimate representative of the Syrian people.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<http://www.france24.com/fr/20121113-paris-syrie-hollande-nouvelle-coalition-opposition-bachar-al-assad-livraisons-armes-asl>).

<a id="event-2012-11-13-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following over 150 rockets being fired into Israel over the past four days from Gaza and attacks by Israel, Egypt has mediated a truce. Both Hamas and Ehud Barak praise the efforts for peace.

Source citations (as archived): [JPost](<http://www.jpost.com/DiplomacyAndPolitics/Article.aspx?id=291678>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The San Marino Common Good alliance wins a majority of the Grand and General Council of San Marino in the Sammarinese general election. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Politics Abroad](<http://www.politicsabroad.com/news/elections/san-marino-common-good-win-general-election/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-11-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A total solar eclipse occurred in parts of Australia and the South Pacific. The most populous city to experience totality was Cairns.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-20320667>).

<a id="event-2012-11-13-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pinch of fine sand and dust became the first solid Martian sample deposited into the Sample Analysis at Mars, the biggest instrument on NASA's Mars rover Curiosity. The sample came from the patch of windblown material called Rocknest, which had provided a sample previously for mineralogical analysis by CheMin instrument.

Source citations (as archived): [JPL-NASA](<http://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/news.php?release=2012-356>).

#### Medicine

<a id="event-2012-11-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scott Routley, a 39-year-old Canadian man, makes medical history by becoming the first person believed to have been in a vegetative state to tell scientists that he is not in any pain. The discovery requires the rewriting of medical textbooks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-20268044>).

### 2012-11-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1237188314](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2014&oldid=1237188314>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Operation Pillar of Defense:.

**Archived source account.** Hamas military chief Ahmed Jabari is killed in a targeted air strike carried out by the Israel Defense Forces and the Shin Bet.

Source citations (as archived): [YNetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4305343,00.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death of a pregnant woman from septicaemia in an Irish hospital prompts international outrage, protests and condemnation. University College Hospital Galway refused numerous requests from Savita Halappanavar and her family for an abortion on the grounds that "this is a Catholic country."

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/this-is-a-catholic-country-woman-dies-of-septicaemia-after-being-refused-an-abortion-in-irish-hospital-8315609.html>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/pregnant-woman-died-after-hospital-denied-abortion-3293842.html>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/india/savita-halappanavar-s-parents-slam-irish-abortion-laws-292871>).

<a id="event-2012-11-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 23-year-old man who accused the award-winning Sesame Street puppeteer Kevin Clash of abusing him while under-age admits he lied.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-20320172>).

<a id="event-2012-11-14-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** John Logue, President of the Union of Students in Ireland, is arrested and taken from Dáil Éireann in handcuffs after turning his back on legislators while peacefully protesting against budget cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [Donegal Daily](<http://www.donegaldaily.com/2012/11/14/picture-drama-donegal-student-leader-arrested-by-gardai-in-dail/>); [University Times](<http://www.universitytimes.ie/2012/11/14/usi-president-arrested-at-dail-education-vote/>).

<a id="event-2012-11-14-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Backed by the Russian domestic security service, Federal Security Service, Russian president Vladimir Putin signs a new treason law, which opponents expect him to use to silence critics and almost anyone who associates with foreigners.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2012/11/14/russia-putin-treason-idINDEE8AD0D220121114>); [Daily Times](<http://www.dailytimes.com.pk/default.asp?page=2012%5C11%5C15%5Cstory_15-11-2012_pg4_1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests against unemployment and austerity measures take place across several European countries. The largest protests reportedly take place in Spain and Portugal, with smaller protests in Greece, Italy, and Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-20320993>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2012/11/2012111491426963893.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/business/2012/nov/14/europe-unite-austerity-protests>).

<a id="event-2012-11-14-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda announces he will dissolve the House of Representatives of the Diet on Friday after the ruling DPJ government and opposition LDP come to an agreement regarding a reduction of seats in the House. A general election is scheduled for December 16. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [NHK](<http://www3.nhk.or.jp/daily/english/20121114_35.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2012-11-14/noda-to-dissolve-diet-nov-16-paving-way-for-japan-election-1-.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-11-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce the discovery of CFBDSIR 2149−0403, the closest known rogue planet to Earth at approximately 100 light-years away.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-20309762>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swedish striker Zlatan Ibrahimović scores four goals in a friendly match against England, with his last coming from a 30-metre bicycle kick.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/sports/soccer/2012/1114/1224326605147.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2012/nov/15/zlatan-ibrahimovic-goal-sweden-england>); [JOE](<http://www.joe.ie/football/videos/video-greeces-goal-against-ireland-tonight-set-to-melancholic-music-0030493-1>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/more-sports/overhead-goal-caps-four-goal-match-article-1.1202215>).

### 2012-11-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1322310238](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2015&oldid=1322310238>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** At least 95 people are killed across Syria according to the Local Coordination Committees, including 46 in Damascus and its suburbs.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/11/15/world/meast/syria-civil-war/index.html?hpt=wo_c2>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** According to the UN refugee office, at least 414,838 Syrians are in neighboring countries registered as refugees or waiting to register. Turkey has the single highest number, with 114,944.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2012/11/15/world/meast/syria-civil-war/index.html?hpt=wo_c2>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's Foreign Minister Ahmet Davutoglu announced that his government recognizes the newly formed Syrian National Coalition as the legitimate leader of the Syrian people, two days after France became the first Western country to recognize the council.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/16/world/middleeast/turkey-recognizes-new-syrian-rebel-group-as-legitimate-leader-of-syria.html?ref=world&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Operation Pillar of Defense:.

**Archived source account.** Three Israeli civilians are killed in Kiryat Malachi, Israel, in a further barrage of rocket attacks on southern Israel from Palestinians in the Gaza Strip. Rockets have hit apartment buildings, schools and private houses so far.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/rockets-rain-down-on-south-after-israel-launches-operation-pillar-of-defense/>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Operation Pillar of Defense:.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian death toll rises to at least 16, including 2 children. Officials in Gaza report at least 150 have been injured since the start of the Israeli operation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/11/20121115135540965773.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-7"></a>

Context: Operation Pillar of Defense:.

**Archived source account.** Two rockets are fired at Tel Aviv, with one landing in the sea and the other hitting an uninhabited area in the city's suburbs. Islamic Jihad has claimed responsibility for the incident, which was the first attack against the city since the 1991 Gulf War.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=291954>); [KleineOnline](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121118053046/http://kleinonline.wnd.com/2012/11/15/rockets-strike-tel-aviv-suburb-hamas-debating-further-escalation-as-israel-continues-large-scale-operation/>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** As nationwide protests over fuel price hikes continue in Jordan, unidentified gunmen storm a police station in the northern town of Irbid, leading to the fatal shooting of 22-year-old civilian, and injuries to 13 police officers and 4 protesters. Protests and sporadic looting are reported from Al Karak, Salt and Madaba.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/11/2012111421456916947.html>).

#### Business and Economy

<a id="event-2012-11-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Deepwater Horizon oil spill:.

**Archived source account.** BP announces it will plead guilty to charges of manslaughter and obstruction of Congress, and will pay a total of US$4.5 billion to the US Department of Justice and Securities and Exchange Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424127887324556304578120140555122104.html?mod=WSJ_hpp_LEFTTopStories>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2012-11-15/bp-resolution-with-doj-includes-4-billion-paid-in-installments.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-1-2"></a>

Context: Deepwater Horizon oil spill:.

**Archived source account.** Separately, the two highest-ranking BP supervisors on board the Deepwater Horizon on the day of the explosion have been indicted on 23 criminal counts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2012/11/15/news/bp-oil-spill-settlement/index.html?hpt=hp_t1>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-11-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Midland train crash.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 17 others are injured in the Midland train crash after a Union Pacific train struck a parade float in Midland, Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121118230829/http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/ct-sns-ap-us-veterans-parade-train-crash-20121115,0,3099824.story>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former BBC Radio 1 disc jockey is detained by police in the ongoing investigation into the Jimmy Savile sexual abuse scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/crime/jimmy-savile/9680420/Dave-Lee-Travis-arrested-as-part-of-Jimmy-Savile-sex-abuse-probe.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-20336798>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Chinese leadership transition at the 18th Party Congress.

**Archived source account.** Xi Jinping is chosen as the General Secretary and Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Chinese Communist Party and the next leader of the People's Republic of China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-20322288#>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Chinese leadership transition at the 18th Party Congress.

**Archived source account.** Other members of the Politburo Standing Committee include Li Keqiang, Zhang Dejiang, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan and Zhang Gaoli.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-20322288>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-4-3"></a>

Context: Chinese leadership transition at the 18th Party Congress.

**Archived source account.** Xi Jinping delivers his first speech as General Secretary in a "plain-spoken" style very different from that of his predecessor, Hu Jintao.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-20338556>); [BBC Transcript](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-20338586>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Myanmar government pardons 452 prisoners under an amnesty in a goodwill gesture before a visit by US President Barack Obama. State media said some of the people released were foreigners, though it remained unknown if any dissidents are among them at all. Human Rights Watch accuses the government of using strategically timed prisoner releases to appease the international community.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia-pacific/2012/11/2012111514445412342.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-15-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elections are held to choose 41 Police and Crime Commissioners in England and Wales. Three by-elections also take place in Cardiff South and Penarth, Corby and Manchester Central.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20331720>).

### 2012-11-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1324130271](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2016&oldid=1324130271>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-11-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hostess Brands announces it will file for bankruptcy and liquidate its assets, stating that a bakery union's worker strike stemming from contract disputes "crippled" its operations. 18,500 workers are expected to be laid off.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2012-11-16/twinkie-maker-hostess-to-shut-down-after-strike.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-16-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The furniture retailer IKEA says it "deeply regrets" the use of political prisoners in the former German Democratic Republic as forced labour by some of its suppliers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-20356945>).

<a id="event-2012-11-16-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Call of Duty: Black Ops II, published by Activision, grossed $500 million within 24 hours, becoming the biggest entertainment launch of all time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/news/9683341/Call-of-duty-Black-Ops-II-sales-hit-500-million-in-first-24-hours.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-11-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are missing and at least 4 are injured after an oil rig exploded in the Gulf of Mexico, near Louisiana.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2012/11/16/fire-on-oil-rig-in-gulf-mexico-coast-guard-officials-say/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-11-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptian Prime Minister Hesham Qandil makes a visit to Gaza City in hopes of lulling the ongoing conflict between Israel and Hamas.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/world/worldnow/la-fg-egytptian-officials-gaza-visit-fails-to-bring-lull-in-violence-20121116,0,7952084.story>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The war crime convictions of Ante Gotovina and Mladen Markač are overturned by a war crimes tribunal in The Hague. The Croatian generals had been convicted and sentenced last year for atrocities against Serbs during the 1990's Yugoslav Wars.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-20352187>).

<a id="event-2012-11-16-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A photo of New York City Counterterrorism Officer Lawrence DePrimo, 25, taken today by an Arizona woman and posted on the New York City Police Department's Facebook page, which shows him buying a (normally $100) pair of waterproof winter boots from Skechers for a homeless Times Square man on 42nd Street without any shoes, goes viral, with 1.6 million views and 275,000 likes.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/50007300>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elections to choose Police and Crime Commissioners in England and Wales are marked by voter apathy with a turnout of just 14.9%. The Electoral Commission says it will investigate the low turnout.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-20344900>).

<a id="event-2012-11-16-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Labour wins all three by-elections contested in the UK on Thursday, including gaining Corby from the Conservatives. Andy Sawford is elected MP for Corby, Lucy Powell for Manchester Central and Stephen Doughty for Cardiff South and Penarth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20345196>).

<a id="event-2012-11-16-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives voted overwhelmingly to end a Jackson–Vanik amendment, long-standing trade restriction with Russia. Also Magnitsky Law was adopted instead, it requires the United States to place financial and visa restrictions on a list of officials associated with the torture and death, three years ago, of Sergei Magnitsky.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/russia-chafes-as-house-passes-magnitsky-bill/2012/11/16/b589e544-300f-11e2-a30e-5ca76eeec857_story.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saint Louis University announces that Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball head coach Rick Majerus will permanently retire due to health issues.

Source citations (as archived): [St. Louis Post-Dispatch](<http://www.stltoday.com/sports/college/slu/majerus-will-not-return-to-slu/article_b6e379d7-f824-5dff-b853-677e9dfd802b.html>).

### 2012-11-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1257120365](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2017&oldid=1257120365>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-17-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suspected insurgents detonate a motorcycle bomb in Mueang Yala District, southern Thailand, killing one person and wounding 20, one day ahead of the United States President Barack Obama’s visit to the country. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/motorcycle-bomb-kills-1-wounds-20-in-southern-thailand-ahead-of-obamas-visit/2012/11/16/f9903d6e-306f-11e2-af17-67abba0676e2_story.html>); [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/breakingnews/321727/yala-bomb-attack-kills-one>).

<a id="event-2012-11-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Operation Pillar of Defense:.

**Archived source account.** Two unguided rockets from Gaza land outside Jerusalem and two more land outside Tel-Aviv. Out of the 350 rockets fired since the start of Operation Pillar of Defense, the Iron Dome missile system has shot down over 200 rockets.

<a id="event-2012-11-18-0-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<http://rt.com/news/anonymous-hack-israel-vice-prime-minister-200/>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Turkey asks for Patriot missiles to be deployed on its territory at the border with Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/11/21/us-syria-crisis-turkey-nato-idUSBRE8AK0UZ20121121>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian warplanes bomb the suburbs of the capital Damascus as fighting continues.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2012/1121/syrian-forces.html>); [Times Live South Africa](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/world/2012/11/21/syrian-troops-besiege-town-on-outskirts-of-damascus>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** In Aleppo, a hospital is bombed by an airstrike, killing 40.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/11/21/world/meast/syria-civil-war/index.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-0-10"></a>

Context: 2012 East DR Congo conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of government soldiers and policemen surrender to M23 rebels at a stadium in the city of Goma, which fell to rebel forces on November 20.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2012/11/201211218184314168.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011–2012 Libyan factional fighting:.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen shoot and kill Benghazi's police chief Faraj al-Deirsy in front of his home in the latest attack against security officials in Libya's second largest city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2012/11/2012112173121714516.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-11-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States bans Tim Pat Coogan, one of Ireland's most recognisable historians and a leading authority on Éamon de Valera and Michael Collins. As a result his book tour is cancelled. The decision is described as a major shock and blot against United States Ambassador to Ireland Dan Rooney.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Central](<http://www.irishcentral.com/news/Tim-Pat-Coogan-book-tour-canceled-after-visa-refusal-180337311.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Will Rogers World Airport in the U.S. state of Oklahoma is shut down over the discovery of a painted golden object with a hole in the bottom in the luggage of musician Wayne Coyne. The object is mistaken for a live grenade by frightened staff.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/music/2012/nov/21/wayne-coyne-oklahoma-airport-grenade>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-11-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mount Tongariro, a volcano on the North Island of New Zealand, erupts for the second time in four months, with efforts underway to rescue people on the Tongariro Alpine Crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/world/nz-volcano-mt-tongariro-erupts/story-fndir2ev-1226521131017?from=public_rss>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Antonov military plane crashes in the Sana'a, capital of Yemen, killing all 10 people on board included five military officers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20426767>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2008 Mumbai attacks.

**Archived source account.** India executes Ajmal Kasab, the lone surviving gunmen in the 2008 Mumbai attacks. He is hanged after his mercy petition is rejected.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2012-11-21/an-indian-executes-mumbai-gunman-kasab/4384266>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rican professional boxer Héctor Camacho is shot multiple times in Bayamon, Puerto Rico. The driver of Camacho's car is killed in the attack. Camacho was shot in the neck and face and taken to St. Paul's Hospital in Río Piedras, where he was pronounced to be in critical condition shortly thereafter.

Source citations (as archived): [El Nuevo Herald](<http://www.elnuevoherald.com/2012/11/21/1348323/el-exboxeador-hector-macho-camacho.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Ireland Michael D. Higgins calls for an investigation into the death of Savita Halappanavar to meet the needs of a "concerned public" as Savita's husband Praveen continues his battle against Ireland's government and the Health Service Executive (HSE) to hold a sworn, public inquiry into her death, which he believes occurred due to her being denied an abortion.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/president-higgins-calls-for-savita-investigation-to-meet-the-needs-of-concerned-public-3302013.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jesse Jackson Jr. resigns from U.S. Congress due to health problems and federal criminal investigation of his activities.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/breaking/chi-brother-rep-jackson-to-announce-resignation-20121121,0,3302727.story>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-11-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Toshiba Corporation unveil a robot that they believe will help in nuclear disasters and could enter the crippled Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant damaged during the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Record](<http://www.dailyrecord.co.uk/news/science-technology/toshiba-unveil-robot-1448363>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-21-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Roberto Di Matteo is sacked by Chelsea F.C. after a 2012–13 UEFA Champions League defeat 0-3 to Juventus F.C. left them in danger of becoming the first title holders to exit the competition in the group stage. Di Matteo managed Chelsea to their first ever Champions League title in Munich last May. Rafael Benítez appointed Chelsea interim manager until end of season.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/1234455>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2012/nov/21/rafael-benitez-chelsea-manager-coach>).

<a id="event-2012-11-21-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2012–13 UEFA Europa League game between Hapoel Ironi Kiryat Shmona F.C. and Athletic Bilbao which was scheduled to take place on 22 November at the Kiryat Eliezer Stadium in Haifa is postponed by UEFA due to the tense security situation in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [UEFA](<http://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/newsid=1895747.html>).

### 2012-11-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1118623021](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2022&oldid=1118623021>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In six terrorist and sectarian attacks across Pakistan over last 24 hours at least 37 people were killed and 92 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/world/2012-11/22/c_131993017.htm>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2012-11-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia lifts a 16-year ban on the import of British beef and lamb. British farmers had been stopped from exporting to Russia following the 1996 BSE outbreak in the UK, despite the lifting of a worldwide ban in 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/travel/destinations/europe/russia/9697289/Russia-lifts-16-year-ban-on-British-beef-and-lamb-imports.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-20454206>).

<a id="event-2012-11-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission gives its backing to commodities giant Glencore's $31 billion (£19.5 billion) bid to take over mining company Xstrata.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-20449079>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-11-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A subway train rear ends another in Busan, South Korea, injuring 40.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of Russia](<https://archive.is/20130417192647/http://english.ruvr.ru/2012_11_22/Subway-accident-in-South-Korea-leaves-40-injured/>).

<a id="event-2012-11-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Up to 120 people are injured and 2 killed near Beaumont, Texas in a 100-vehicle pileup in dense fog that forced the closure of both directions of Interstate 10 in Southeast Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/11/22/us-usa-texas-crash-idUSBRE8AL0RB20121122>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A hostage situation in the northern city of Thessaloniki, Greece, ends peacefully, as policemen arrest a 72-year-old Greek pensioner who was threatening to set a tax office building on fire due to a financial dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [Global Times](<http://www.globaltimes.cn/content/745964.shtml>).

<a id="event-2012-11-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli police and Shin Bet arrest several suspects in relation to the bombing of a public bus in Tel Aviv. The suspects claim affiliation with Hamas and Islamic Jihad and reveal they planted the bomb on the bus and detonated it remotely using a cell phone.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=293140>).

<a id="event-2012-11-22-3-2"></a>

#### Media

<a id="event-2012-11-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The BBC appoints Tony Hall, Baron Hall of Birkenhead, as the new Director-General of the corporation after the resignation of George Entwistle earlier this month due to the Newsnight controversy. He is expected to start in the role in early March 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/bbc-confirms-tony-hall-to-be-appointed-new-directorgeneral-8343625.html>).

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan is set to remove a block placed on YouTube more than two months ago over a controversial anti-Islamic video Innocence of Muslims.

<a id="event-2012-11-22-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Lord Chancellor Chris Grayling tells the House of Commons that a European Court of Human Rights ruling on prisoner votes can be defied.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20431995>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-11-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sandy Island, a South Pacific island, shown on marine charts and world maps as well as on Google Earth, does not exist, Australian scientists say.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-20442487>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Register](<https://www.theregister.co.uk/2012/11/21/makemake_has_no_atmopshere_says_eos/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-22-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian Premier League awards FC Dynamo Moscow a technical 3-0 victory after a league match in Arena Khimki on 17 November was abandoned when a goalkeeper Anton Shunin was hurt by a firecracker thrown from the FC Zenit Saint Petersburg supporters end.

### 2012-11-23

One of the pilots, guiding his aircraft away from a populated area, is killed. Three soldiers are also injured in the crash.

<a id="event-2012-11-23-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Harry Redknapp is appointed as the manager of Queens Park Rangers, taking over from Mark Hughes whose contract was terminated after fail to win any of their 12 Premier League games this season.

<a id="event-2012-11-23-5-1"></a>

<a id="event-2012-11-29-4-2"></a>

Context: Leveson report:.

<a id="event-2012-11-29-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** George H. W. Bush is admitted in stable condition to The Methodist Hospital of the Texas Medical Center in Houston, Texas. #### Science and technology

### 2012-11-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076371191](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20November%2030&oldid=1076371191>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-11-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unpublished list compiled by Mexico's Attorney General's Office is leaked showing that more than 25,000 people disappeared in Mexico's drug war, placing the probable death toll of the six-year conflict at around 100,000 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/mexico-more-than-25000-people-disappear-in-six-years-8372482.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-11-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Ilyushin Il-76 cargo plane belonging to Aéro-Service, flying from Pointe Noire to Brazzaville, capital of the Republic of the Congo, crashes into houses near Maya-Maya Airport during a thunderstorm. Congolese Red Cross officials say at least 32 people are confirmed dead in the crash, including six crew members and a police officer on board, as the search for victims continues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20563655>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/12/01/us-congo-republic-crash-idUSBRE8B006720121201>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/breaking-news/plane-crashes-houses-in-congo-killing-30/story-fn3dxix6-1226527884699>); [BNO News](<https://archive.is/20130110190409/http://www.bnowire.com/?p=1031>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A railway bridge collapses over a creek in Paulsboro in southern New Jersey, causing a Conrail freight train to derail and spill hazardous chemicals into the air and water.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/11/30/us-usa-train-derailment-idUSBRE8AT0PF20121130>); [NY Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/train-derails-n-spills-toxic-chemicals-article-1.1210839>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and more than ten others injured in a gas explosion and fire in an apartment building in the Siberian city of Tomsk, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/russia/20121130/177839313.html>); [ITAR-TASS](<http://www.itar-tass.com/c154/586354.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A freight train derails at the Stuttgart-Feuerbach station, Germany, after a collision with the railway platform. There were no reports of injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuttgarter-Zeitung](<http://www.stuttgarter-zeitung.de/inhalt.schwerer-unfall-in-stuttgart-feuerbach-waggons-rasen-in-bahnhof-feuerbach.86e49a06-9064-42af-a3d2-a3adcff20ec0.html>); [SWR](<http://www.swr.de/nachrichten/bw/-/id=1622/nid=1622/did=10657866/pv=gallery/vx3ksw/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-11-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A murder–suicide attack occurs in Casper, Wyoming, United States. Two people are murdered, including a female computer science instructor (off campus), and a male faculty member that she'd been seeing (in a classroom) at Casper College, before the perpetrator, the male professor's son, killed himself in the classroom.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/11/30/15574250-bow-and-arrow-attack-leaves-3-dead-at-casper-college-in-wyoming-officials-say>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New Hampshire federal grand jury indicts David Kwiatkowski, 33, a former employee of Exeter Hospital in Exeter, New Hampshire, on fraud and product-tampering charges in connection with an outbreak of hepatitis C that sickened more than 30 people and caused concern in 7 states.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2012/11/29/health/hepatitis-infections-indictment/index.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Qatari author Mohammed al-Ajami is given a life sentence for a poem insulting emir Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/qatari-poet-jailed-for-insulting-emir/2012/11/29/eb5e095c-3a41-11e2-a263-f0ebffed2f15_story.html>); [RT](<http://rt.com/news/qatar-poet-life-sentence-922/>); [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/30/world/middleeast/qatari-poet-sentenced-to-life-in-prison-for-a-verse.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20550160>).

#### Media

<a id="event-2012-11-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Time magazine editors announce their list of 38 contenders nominated as the 2012 Time Person of the Year, including Barack Obama, Mitt Romney, Sheldon Adelson, Malala Yousafzai, Sandra Fluke, Felix Baumgartner, Curiosity rover, Bashar Assad, Mohamed Morsi, Psy, Pussy Riot, Higgs boson, Michael Phelps, and others. The winner of the people's choice will be announced on 14 December.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://www.time.com/time/person-of-the-year/2012/>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121201085539/http://news.msn.com/pop-culture/psy-and-jay-z-nominated-for-times-person-of-the-year-1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-11-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Labour Party wins the three by-elections held in the United Kingdom on Thursday. Steve Reed is elected in Croydon North, Andy McDonald in Middlesbrough and Sarah Champion in Rotherham. The UK Independence Party achieve second place in Middlesbrough and Rotherham, beating the Conservatives and Liberal Democrats.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20541136>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Victims of press intrusion launch an online campaign to urge British Prime Minister David Cameron to fully implement the recommendations of the Leveson report.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-20559833>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2012-11-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small humanoid robot that can talk will be sent into space to provide conversational company for Japanese astronaut Koichi Wakata on a six-month mission to the ISS during Soyuz TMA-11M in 2013. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20121130-robot-buddy-keep-japan-astronaut-company>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA debunks rumors of new evidence of life on Mars, but its Curiosity rover continues to make many smaller discoveries.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-205_162-57556453/mars-rover-curiosity-continues-drilling-amid-rumors/>); [Space.com](<http://www.space.com/18697-mars-rover-curiosity-discovery-rumors.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first direct photograph of DNA, by Enzo Di Fabrizio, a physics professor at Magna Graecia University in Catanzaro, Italy, is taken. He used an electron microscope (not the usual X-ray crystallography) and a nanoscopic landscape of extremely water-repellant silicon pillars (the water evaporated quickly and left behind the DNA).

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/50029929/ns/technology_and_science-science/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2012-11-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian Premier League is looking at setting up a pan-CIS football league, as analog of KHL in ice hockey or VTB United League in basketball, after several clubs expressed an interest.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/sports/20121130/177840755.html>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former England cricket captain Andrew Flintoff makes his debut as a professional boxer, and wins his first fight against Richard Dawson.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/boxing/20563918>).

<a id="event-2012-11-30-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following Israel's recent assault on Gaza, some footballers sign a letter of condemnation against plans to hold the 2013 UEFA European Under-21 Football Championship in Israel next summer; among the signatories are Eden Hazard, Abou Diaby, Papiss Cissé, Cheick Tioté, Sylvain Marveaux, Yohan Cabaye, Demba Ba, Didier Drogba and Frédéric Kanouté.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/sport/2012/1201/1224327341829.html>); [ESPN](<http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/1246310/didier-drogba-among-stars-declaring-support-for-palestine>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/news/9715577/Premier-League-players-call-on-Uefa-to-remove-Israel-as-European-U-21-hosts.html>).


## December

### 2012-12-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1276175193](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20December%201&oldid=1276175193>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-12-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian jets bombard rebel positions in Damascus as a country-wide Internet and phone blackout enters a third day. Government officials announce the road to the airport in the capital has been secured, though rebels insist clashes are ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/12/01/us-syria-crisis-idUSBRE8AJ1FK20121201>).

<a id="event-2012-12-01-0-3"></a>

Context: 2012 East D.R. Congo conflict:.

**Archived source account.** M23 rebels begin their withdrawal from the city of Goma as part of a Uganda-brokered deal struck a week earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/12/01/us-congo-democratic-idUSBRE8B005Y20121201>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-12-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anastasiya Petryk from Ukraine wins the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2012 with her song Nebo (Sky) which got 138 points.

Source citations (as archived): [Eurovision](<http://www.eurovision.tv/page/news?id=ukraine_wins_the_10th_junior_eurovision_song_contest>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-12-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tour bus hits a bridge at Miami International Airport, United States, killing at least two people and injuring many more. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/12/01/15596338-tour-bus-hits-miami-airport-overpass-2-dead-others-hurt>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-20567153>); [The Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/2012/12/01/3121896/several-injured-one-possibly-dead.html>).

<a id="event-2012-12-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 8 people are killed and 36 injured when a passenger bus overturns on the highway between the cities of Sucre and Potosí in southern Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/world/20121202/177867313.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2012-12-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea's state agency KCNA announces the country will launch a satellite sometime between December 10 and December 22. The launch will take place around the time of South Korea's presidential election on December 19 and close to the first anniversary of the death of former leader Kim Jong-il. South Korean officials, as well as the US, believe that the isolated state is testing long-range missile technology with the aim of developing an intercontinental ballistic missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2012/12/01/us-korea-north-launch-idUSBRE8B004P20121201>).

<a id="event-2012-12-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Foreign ministers of the Arab League meet in Istanbul, Turkey, to show their support for the Syrian opposition groups and Palestinians.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2012/12/01/turkey-hosts-arab-foreign-ministers-in-show-support-for-syrian-opposition/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-12-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Notorious Macau gangster Broken Tooth Koi is released from prison after serving nearly 15 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-20564556>).

<a id="event-2012-12-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jovan Belcher, a linebacker for the Kansas City Chiefs American football team kills himself at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri, United States, after reportedly killing his girlfriend.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/9716347/American-football-player-with-Kansas-City-Chiefs-kills-himself-at-team-stadium.html>).

Context: Mexican inauguration:.

**Archived source account.** Enrique Peña Nieto of the Institutional Revolutionary Party is sworn in as the President of Mexico as violent clashes occur outside.

<a id="event-2012-12-01-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 23 people are severely wounded outside the Camara de Diputados during the protests in Mexico City.

**Archived source account.** President of Egypt Mohamed Morsi announces that the country's new draft constitution will be put to a constitutional referendum on December 15.

**Archived source account.** The USS Enterprise, the world's first nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, is officially inactivated in ceremonies held at Naval Station Norfolk, Virginia, completing a 51-year career in the United States Navy. Finucane's wife says, "The British government has engineered a suppression of the truth behind the murder of my husband."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2012/dec/12/pat-finucane-family-report-sham>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/british-agents-facilitated-the-murder-of-pat-finucane-3324832.html>).

### 2012-12-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351314157](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2012%20December%2018&oldid=1351314157>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2012-12-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** NBC News Chief Foreign Correspondent Richard Engel and his production team are freed after 5 days of captivity in northern Syria. They were captured by what Engel claims were members of the shabiha, a plainclothes militia loyal to President Bashar al-Assad. Rebel forces at a checkpoint freed the men after a firefight that killed 2 of the captors.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://worldnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/12/18/15985279-richard-engel-and-nbc-news-team-freed-from-captors-in-syria>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-0-3"></a>

Context: 2012 Central African Republic rebellion:.

**Archived source account.** A coalition of rebel groups called Séléka take over the Central African Republic mining town of Bria, killing at least 15 government soldiers. The group is spearheaded by UFDR forces and has already taken five towns in its two-week offensive, which it claims is because of a lack of progress after a peace deal ended the 2004–2007 Bush War. Following an appeal for help from President François Bozizé, the President of Chad Idriss Déby sends 20 vehicles of heavily armed troops to help quell the rebellion.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/rebels-african-republic-towns-18005886>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hqiANCbhHZd4zl8TI3P8i6OtqN2g>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130313021434/http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/car-rebels-take-diamond-mining-town-kill-15-soldiers>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-0-5"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency:.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill six health workers engaged in a polio vaccination drive in Pakistan, highlighting resistance to a program opposed by the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/1721729/Six-polio-workers-shot-dead-in-Pakistan>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2012-12-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The premiere of Quentin Tarantino's new movie Django Unchained is cancelled as a response to the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/people/2012/12/17/djanjo-unchained-premiere-canceled/1776155/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2012-12-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and seven injured after an apartment block collapses in the center of Palermo in Italy. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/four-killed-as-sicilian-apartment-buildings-collapse/>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large, 33.5-ton aquarium bursts in a busy shopping center on the Nanjing Road pedestrian mall in Shanghai, China, injuring 15 people, including customers and shop staff.

Source citations (as archived): [East Day](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121230182959/http://english.eastday.com/e/121219/u1a7072406.html>); [The Inquisitr](<http://www.inquisitr.com/450257/shark-tank-bursts-at-shanghai-shopping-center-video/>); [RT](<http://rt.com/news/shanghai-explosion-tank-sharks-815/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the recent death of Savita Halappanavar, the Irish government is to introduce legislation to clarify the Republic of Ireland's abortion laws, giving doctors clear guidelines on procedures where the mother's life is at risk.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-20768743>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The High Court of England and Wales rules that a seven-year-old boy with a brain tumour should undergo surgery against his mother's wishes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-20769155>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of Richard Hickock and Perry Smith, the murderers who were the subject of Truman Capote's non-fiction novel In Cold Blood, are exhumed in the US state of Kansas to help solve a cold case in Florida from December 1959.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/truman-capotes-in-cold-blood-killers-bodies-exhumed-over-florida-murder/story-e6frg6so-1226540272723>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A police officer's claim that he witnessed a conflict outside Downing Street involving former British Conservative Party Chief Whip Andrew Mitchell is being probed by the Independent Police Complaints Commission. CCTV footage of the incident also emerges, casting doubt on whether any witnesses were present at the time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20764044>); [Channel 4 News](<http://www.channel4.com/news/andrew-mitchell-plebgate-police-cctv-downing-street>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At the High Court of England and Wales, the BBC and ITV apologise to Lord McAlpine for "disastrously" and falsely linking him to allegations of child sex abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2012/dec/18/bbc-itv-apologise-lord-mcalpine>).

<a id="event-2012-12-18-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Congolese militia leader Mathieu Ngudjolo Chui is acquitted by the International Criminal Court of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20766597>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2012-12-18-4-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-20757382>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2012/dec/18/queen-attends-cabinet-meeting>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1026909/queen-at-downing-street-for-cabinet-meeting>).

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/topstories/article.aspx?id=827902>).

**Archived source account.** The President of Iraq, Jalal Talabani, has a stroke with his condition reported as stable.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://worldnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/12/18/15988757-iraq-president-talabani-stable-after-stroke>).

Johnson in 1964 and 1967.

<a id="event-2012-12-19-5-3"></a>

Bush, still receiving visitors, remains hospitalized (since 23 November) at The Methodist Hospital in Houston, Texas, where he resides during the winter, with a receding bronchitis-like cough but with a now-rising and long-lasting fever, and has been put in intensive care on a liquids-only diet for unspecified reasons.

His was one of three names known to have been submitted by the state party's central committee, along with an unnamed person and U.S. Democrat Colleen Hanabusa, whom Inouye had stated as his preferred successor hours before his death.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://politicalticker.blogs.cnn.com/2012/12/26/hawaii-governor-names-new-senator-lt-gov-brian-schatz/>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts
